name: MathFin.compoundPoisson_mgf
statement:
theorem compoundPoisson_mgf (lam : ℝ≥0) (t : ℝ) (X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ)
    (hindep : iIndepFun X μ) (hmeas : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (hident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) μ μ) :
    ∫ n, mgf (fun ω ↦ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, X i ω) μ t ∂(poissonMeasure lam)
      = Real.exp ((lam : ℝ) * (mgf (X 0) μ t - 1))

    (hident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) μ μ) (n : ℕ) :

name: MathFin.americanPrice_succ
statement:
lemma americanPrice_succ (u d r : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (S : ℝ) :
    americanPrice u d r g (n + 1) S = max (g S)

        (americanPrice u d r g n (S * d)))

name: MathFin.bermudanPrice_mono
statement:
lemma bermudanPrice_mono {u d r : ℝ} (h : BinomialNoArb u d r) (g : ℝ → ℝ)
    {E₁ E₂ : Set ℕ} (hE : E₁ ⊆ E₂) (n : ℕ) (S : ℝ) :
    bermudanPrice E₁ u d r g n S ≤ bermudanPrice E₂ u d r g n S

name: MathFin.bermudanPrice_succ
statement:
lemma bermudanPrice_succ (E : Set ℕ) (u d r : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (S : ℝ) :
    bermudanPrice E u d r g (n + 1) S =
      if (n + 1) ∈ E then
        max (g S) (binomialOptionPriceOnePeriod u d r
          (bermudanPrice E u d r g n (S * u)) (bermudanPrice E u d r g n (S * d)))
      else
        binomialOptionPriceOnePeriod u d r
          (bermudanPrice E u d r g n (S * u)) (bermudanPrice E u d r g n (S * d))

statement:
lemma bermudanPrice_univ (u d r : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (S : ℝ) :

name: MathFin.bermudan_sandwich
statement:
lemma bermudan_sandwich
    {Eur Berm Amer : Finset ι}
    (hEB : Eur ⊆ Berm) (hBA : Berm ⊆ Amer) (hEurNE : Eur.Nonempty)
    (v : ι → ℝ) :
    Eur.sup' hEurNE v ≤ Berm.sup' (hEurNE.mono hEB) v ∧
      Berm.sup' (hEurNE.mono hEB) v ≤ Amer.sup' (hEurNE.mono (hEB.trans hBA)) v

    binomialPrice u d r g n S ≤ bermudanPrice E u d r g n S ∧
      bermudanPrice E u d r g n S ≤ americanPrice u d r g n S

name: MathFin.binomialPrice_callPut_parity
statement:
lemma binomialPrice_callPut_parity {u d r K : ℝ} (h : BinomialNoArb u d r) (n : ℕ) (S : ℝ) :
    binomialPrice u d r (fun x ↦ max (x - K) 0) n S
      = binomialPrice u d r (fun x ↦ max (K - x) 0) n S
        + (S - K * Real.exp (-(n : ℝ) * r))

name: MathFin.binomialPrice_call_tendsto_bs
statement:
theorem binomialPrice_call_tendsto_bs {r σ T S₀ K : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (hT : 0 < T) (hS₀ : 0 < S₀)
    (hna : ∀ n, 0 < n → BinomialNoArb (crrUp σ T n) (crrDown σ T n) (crrPerStepRate r T n)) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ binomialPrice (crrUp σ T n) (crrDown σ T n) (crrPerStepRate r T n)
        (fun x ↦ max (x - K) 0) n S₀) atTop
      (𝓝 (Real.exp (-(r * T)) * ∫ x, max (K - S₀ * Real.exp x) 0
          ∂(gaussianReal ((r - σ ^ 2 / 2) * T) (σ ^ 2 * T).toNNReal)
        + (S₀ - K * Real.exp (-(r * T)))))

name: MathFin.crrStepCharFun_eq
statement:
lemma crrStepCharFun_eq (r σ T : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    crrStepCharFun r σ T n t
      = ↑(Real.cos (σ * Real.sqrt (T / n) * t))
        + ↑((2 * crrProb r σ T n - 1) * Real.sin (σ * Real.sqrt (T / n) * t)) * I

name: MathFin.crr_charFun_pow_tendsto
statement:
theorem crr_charFun_pow_tendsto (hσ : 0 < σ) (hT : 0 < T) (t : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ crrStepCharFun r σ T n t ^ n) atTop
      (𝓝 (Complex.exp (I * Complex.ofReal ((r - σ ^ 2 / 2) * T) * Complex.ofReal t
        - Complex.ofReal (σ ^ 2 * T) * Complex.ofReal t ^ 2 / 2)))

name: MathFin.crr_charFun_pow_tendsto_gaussian

theorem crr_charFun_pow_tendsto_gaussian (hσ : 0 < σ) (hT : 0 < T) (t : ℝ) :

      (𝓝 (MeasureTheory.charFun
        (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal ((r - σ ^ 2 / 2) * T) (σ ^ 2 * T).toNNReal) t))

    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ crrRowProbMeasure r σ T n (hp n).1 (hp n).2) atTop

name: MathFin.binomialPrice_call_tendsto_bs_closed
statement:
theorem binomialPrice_call_tendsto_bs_closed {r σ T S₀ K : ℝ}
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hT : 0 < T) (hS₀ : 0 < S₀) (hK : 0 < K)
    (hna : ∀ n, 0 < n → BinomialNoArb (crrUp σ T n) (crrDown σ T n) (crrPerStepRate r T n)) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ binomialPrice (crrUp σ T n) (crrDown σ T n) (crrPerStepRate r T n)
        (fun x ↦ max (x - K) 0) n S₀) atTop

name: MathFin.exp_neg_mul_integral_put_gaussian_eq
statement:
lemma exp_neg_mul_integral_put_gaussian_eq {r σ T S₀ K : ℝ}
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hT : 0 < T) (hS₀ : 0 < S₀) (hK : 0 < K) :
    Real.exp (-(r * T)) * ∫ x, max (K - S₀ * Real.exp x) 0
        ∂(gaussianReal ((r - σ ^ 2 / 2) * T) (σ ^ 2 * T).toNNReal)
      = K * Real.exp (-(r * T)) * Phi (-(bsd2 S₀ K r σ T))
        - S₀ * Phi (-(bsd1 S₀ K r σ T))

name: MathFin.binomial_QV_per_step_eq
statement:
theorem binomial_QV_per_step_eq (r σ T : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    crrProb r σ T n * (Real.log (crrUp σ T n)) ^ 2 +
    (1 - crrProb r σ T n) * (Real.log (crrDown σ T n)) ^ 2 -
    (crrProb r σ T n * Real.log (crrUp σ T n) +
      (1 - crrProb r σ T n) * Real.log (crrDown σ T n)) ^ 2 =
        binomialLogReturnQV r σ T n

name: MathFin.binomial_discrete_ito_convergence

theorem binomial_discrete_ito_convergence
    {σ T r : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (hT : 0 < T) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ (n : ℝ) * binomialLogReturnDrift r σ T n)
        atTop (𝓝 ((r - σ ^ 2 / 2) * T)) ∧
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ (n : ℝ) * binomialLogReturnQV r σ T n)
        atTop (𝓝 (σ ^ 2 * T))

theorem crr_drift_limit_h {σ : ℝ} (hσ : σ ≠ 0) (r : ℝ) :

          / (h * (Real.exp (σ * h) - Real.exp (-(σ * h)))))

name: MathFin.tendsto_crr_numerator_div_sq

lemma tendsto_crr_numerator_div_sq (σ r : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun h : ℝ ↦
        (2 * Real.exp (r * h^2) - Real.exp (σ * h) - Real.exp (-(σ * h))) / h^2)
      (𝓝[≠] 0) (𝓝 (2 * r - σ^2))

statement:
lemma tendsto_exp_sym_sub_two_div_sq (σ : ℝ) :

      (𝓝[≠] 0) (𝓝 (σ^2))

name: MathFin.binomialRN_expectation_one
statement:
theorem binomialRN_expectation_one (p q : ℝ)
    (hp : p ≠ 0) (hp1 : p ≠ 1) :
    p * binomialRN p q true + (1 - p) * binomialRN p q false = 1

name: MathFin.binomial_riskNeutral_via_RN
statement:
theorem binomial_riskNeutral_via_RN (p q V_u V_d : ℝ)
    (hp : p ≠ 0) (hp1 : p ≠ 1) :
    q * V_u + (1 - q) * V_d =
      p * binomialRN p q true * V_u + (1 - p) * binomialRN p q false * V_d

name: MathFin.binomial_martingale_representation
statement:
theorem binomial_martingale_representation
    (hM_adapt : ∀ n, PathAdaptedAt n (M n)) (hS_adapt : ∀ n, PathAdaptedAt n (S n))
    (hM_mart : ∀ n ω, q * M (n + 1) (Function.update ω n true)
        + (1 - q) * M (n + 1) (Function.update ω n false) = M n ω)
    (hS_mart : ∀ n ω, q * S (n + 1) (Function.update ω n true)
        + (1 - q) * S (n + 1) (Function.update ω n false) = S n ω)
    (hS_nondeg : ∀ n ω, S (n + 1) (Function.update ω n true)
        ≠ S (n + 1) (Function.update ω n false)) :
    ∃ H : ℕ → (ℕ → Bool) → ℝ, (∀ n, PathAdaptedAt n (H n)) ∧
      ∀ N ω, M N ω = M 0 ω + ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, H k ω * (S (k + 1) ω - S k ω)

name: MathFin.repr_one_step
statement:
theorem repr_one_step
    (hM_mart : ∀ n ω, q * M (n + 1) (Function.update ω n true)
        + (1 - q) * M (n + 1) (Function.update ω n false) = M n ω)
    (hS_mart : ∀ n ω, q * S (n + 1) (Function.update ω n true)
        + (1 - q) * S (n + 1) (Function.update ω n false) = S n ω)
    (hS_nondeg : ∀ n ω, S (n + 1) (Function.update ω n true)
        ≠ S (n + 1) (Function.update ω n false))
    (n : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → Bool) :
    M (n + 1) ω - M n ω = hedgeRatio M S n ω * (S (n + 1) ω - S n ω)

name: MathFin.binomialPrice_succ
statement:
lemma binomialPrice_succ (u d r : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (S : ℝ) :
    binomialPrice u d r g (n + 1) S =
      Real.exp (-r) *
        (crrUpProb u d r * binomialPrice u d r g n (S * u) +
         (1 - crrUpProb u d r) * binomialPrice u d r g n (S * d))

      binomialOptionPriceOnePeriod u d r
        (binomialPrice u d r g n (S * u))
        (binomialPrice u d r g n (S * d))

name: MathFin.americanPrice_is_snell_envelope
statement:
theorem americanPrice_is_snell_envelope
    {u d r : ℝ} (h : BinomialNoArb u d r) (g : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (∀ n S, g S ≤ americanPrice u d r g n S) ∧
    (∀ n S,
      binomialOptionPriceOnePeriod u d r
        (americanPrice u d r g n (S * u)) (americanPrice u d r g n (S * d)) ≤
      americanPrice u d r g (n + 1) S) ∧
    (∀ (V : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ),
      (∀ n S, g S ≤ V n S) →
      (∀ n S,
        binomialOptionPriceOnePeriod u d r (V n (S * u)) (V n (S * d)) ≤
          V (n + 1) S) →
      ∀ n S, americanPrice u d r g n S ≤ V n S)

    (hV_g : ∀ n S, g S ≤ V n S)
    (hV_super : ∀ n S,
      binomialOptionPriceOnePeriod u d r (V n (S * u)) (V n (S * d)) ≤
        V (n + 1) S) :
    ∀ n S, americanPrice u d r g n S ≤ V n S

statement:
theorem americanPrice_snell_minimal (u d r : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ) (S₀ : ℝ)
    (hna : BinomialNoArb u d r) {U : ℕ → (ℕ → Bool) → ℝ}
    (hU_super : ∀ (k : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → Bool),
      crrUpProb u d r * U (k + 1) (Function.update ω k true)
        + (1 - crrUpProb u d r) * U (k + 1) (Function.update ω k false) ≤ U k ω)
    (hU_ge : ∀ (k : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → Bool),
      Real.exp (-r * k) * g (spotPath S₀ u d k ω) ≤ U k ω)
    (N k : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → Bool) :
    Real.exp (-r * k) * americanPrice u d r g (N - k) (spotPath S₀ u d k ω) ≤ U k ω

name: MathFin.discounted_americanPrice_supermartingale
statement:
theorem discounted_americanPrice_supermartingale (u d r : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ) (S₀ : ℝ)
    {N k : ℕ} (hk : k < N) (ω : ℕ → Bool) :
    crrUpProb u d r * (Real.exp (-r * (k + 1 : ℕ)) *
        americanPrice u d r g (N - (k + 1))
          (spotPath S₀ u d (k + 1) (Function.update ω k true)))
      + (1 - crrUpProb u d r) * (Real.exp (-r * (k + 1 : ℕ)) *
        americanPrice u d r g (N - (k + 1))
          (spotPath S₀ u d (k + 1) (Function.update ω k false)))
      ≤ Real.exp (-r * k) * americanPrice u d r g (N - k) (spotPath S₀ u d k ω)

theorem curve_hasDeriv {U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ} {b : ℝ → ℝ} {t : ℝ}
    (hU : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => U z.1 z.2) (b t,t))
    (hb : DifferentiableAt ℝ b t) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => U (b s) s)
      (deriv (U (b t)) t + deriv b t * deriv (fun x => U x t) (b t)) t

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.ProfileData.hasDeriv
statement: theorem hasDeriv (h : ProfileData β ρ F) (z : ℝ) : HasDerivAt F (deriv F z) z

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.ProfileData.hasDeriv_deriv
statement:
theorem hasDeriv_deriv (h : ProfileData β ρ F) (z : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (deriv F) (deriv (deriv F) z) z

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.ProfileData.pos
statement: theorem pos (h : ProfileData β ρ F) (z : ℝ) : 0 < F z

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.excess_deriv2
statement:
theorem excess_deriv2 (hf : ProfileData (α - c) k f)
    (hg : ProfileData (α + 2 - c) h g) (ℓ z : ℝ) :
    deriv (deriv (excess f g ℓ)) z = deriv (deriv f) z - Real.exp (ℓ + z) *
      (g z - 1 + 2 * deriv g z + deriv (deriv g) z)

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.excess_equation
statement:
theorem excess_equation (hα : α = k - h - 1)
    (hf : ProfileData (α - c) k f) (hg : ProfileData (α + 2 - c) h g) (ℓ z : ℝ) :
    deriv (deriv (excess f g ℓ)) z + (α - c) * deriv (excess f g ℓ) z -
      k * excess f g ℓ z =
        k - h * Real.exp (ℓ + z) + c * Real.exp (ℓ + z) * (g z - 1)

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.excess_forcing_nonneg
statement:
theorem excess_forcing_nonneg (hα : α = k - h - 1)
    (hf : ProfileData (α - c) k f) (hg : ProfileData (α + 2 - c) h g)
    (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hhk : h ≤ k) (hc : 0 ≤ c) {ℓ z : ℝ} (hx : ℓ + z ≤ 0) :
    0 ≤ deriv (deriv (excess f g ℓ)) z + (α - c) * deriv (excess f g ℓ) z -
      k * excess f g ℓ z

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.excess_hasDeriv
statement:
theorem excess_hasDeriv (hf : ProfileData (α - c) k f)
    (hg : ProfileData (α + 2 - c) h g) (ℓ z : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (excess f g ℓ)
      (deriv f z - Real.exp (ℓ + z) * (g z - 1 + deriv g z)) z

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.excess_initial
statement:
theorem excess_initial (hf : ProfileData (α - c) k f)
    (hg : ProfileData (α + 2 - c) h g) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    excess f g ℓ 0 = 0 ∧ deriv (excess f g ℓ) 0 = 0

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.excess_nonneg
statement:
theorem excess_nonneg (hα : α = k - h - 1)
    (hf : ProfileData (α - c) k f) (hg : ProfileData (α + 2 - c) h g)
    (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hhk : h ≤ k) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    {ℓ z : ℝ} (hℓ : ℓ ≤ 0) (hx : ℓ + z ≤ 0) : 0 ≤ excess f g ℓ z

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.initialRatio_hasDeriv
statement:
theorem initialRatio_hasDeriv (hf : ProfileData (α - c) k f)
    (hg : ProfileData (α + 2 - c) h g) (z : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (initialRatio f g)
      (initialRatio f g z * (logSlope f z - logSlope g z - 1)) z

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.initialRatio_pos
statement:
theorem initialRatio_pos (hf : ProfileData (α - c) k f)
    (hg : ProfileData (α + 2 - c) h g) (z : ℝ) : 0 < initialRatio f g z

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.logSlope_hasDeriv
statement:
theorem logSlope_hasDeriv {β ρ : ℝ} {F : ℝ → ℝ} (hF : ProfileData β ρ F) (z : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (logSlope F) (ρ - β * logSlope F z - logSlope F z ^ 2) z

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.positive_root_gap
statement:
theorem positive_root_gap (hα : α = k - h - 1) (hk : 0 < k) (hc : 0 < c)
    {μ : ℝ} (hμ : 0 ≤ μ) (heq : μ ^ 2 + (α + 2 - c) * μ - h = 0) :
    μ + 1 < positiveRoot (α - c) k

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.price_deriv2_x
statement:
theorem price_deriv2_x (hf : ProfileData (α - c) k f)
    (hg : ProfileData (α + 2 - c) h g) (x t : ℝ) :
    deriv (deriv (fun y => price f g c d y t)) x =
      deriv (deriv f) (x + c * t - d) - Real.exp x *
        (g (x + c * t - d) + 2 * deriv g (x + c * t - d) +
          deriv (deriv g) (x + c * t - d))

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.price_dominates_intrinsic
statement:
theorem price_dominates_intrinsic (hα : α = k - h - 1)
    (hf : ProfileData (α - c) k f) (hg : ProfileData (α + 2 - c) h g)
    (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hhk : h ≤ k) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hd : d ≤ 0)
    {x t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hx : x ≤ 0) : 1 - Real.exp x ≤ price f g c d x t

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.price_equation
statement:
theorem price_equation (hα : α = k - h - 1)
    (hf : ProfileData (α - c) k f) (hg : ProfileData (α + 2 - c) h g) (x t : ℝ) :
    deriv (price f g c d x) t =
      deriv (deriv (fun y => price f g c d y t)) x +
        α * deriv (fun y => price f g c d y t) x - k * price f g c d x t

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.price_hasDeriv_t
statement:
theorem price_hasDeriv_t (hf : ProfileData (α - c) k f)
    (hg : ProfileData (α + 2 - c) h g) (x t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (price f g c d x)
      (c * (deriv f (x + c * t - d) - Real.exp x * deriv g (x + c * t - d))) t

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.price_hasDeriv_x
statement:
theorem price_hasDeriv_x (hf : ProfileData (α - c) k f)
    (hg : ProfileData (α + 2 - c) h g) (x t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => price f g c d y t)
      (deriv f (x + c * t - d) - Real.exp x *
        (g (x + c * t - d) + deriv g (x + c * t - d))) x

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.price_smooth_fit_on_line
statement:
theorem price_smooth_fit_on_line (hf : ProfileData (α - c) k f)
    (hg : ProfileData (α + 2 - c) h g) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun x => price f g c d x t) (-Real.exp (d - c * t)) (d - c * t)

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.price_value_on_line
statement:
theorem price_value_on_line (hf : ProfileData (α - c) k f)
    (hg : ProfileData (α + 2 - c) h g) (t : ℝ) :
    price f g c d (d - c * t) t = 1 - Real.exp (d - c * t)

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.profile_data
statement: theorem profile_data {β ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) : ProfileData β ρ (profile β ρ)

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.rootProfile_deriv
statement:
theorem rootProfile_deriv (u v z : ℝ) :
    deriv (rootProfile u v) z =
      (u * (Real.exp (v * z) * v) - v * (Real.exp (u * z) * u)) / (u - v)

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.rootProfile_deriv2
statement:
theorem rootProfile_deriv2 (u v z : ℝ) :
    deriv (deriv (rootProfile u v)) z =
      (u * (Real.exp (v * z) * v * v) -
        v * (Real.exp (u * z) * u * u)) / (u - v)

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.rootProfile_deriv_zero
statement: theorem rootProfile_deriv_zero (u v : ℝ) : deriv (rootProfile u v) 0 = 0

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.rootProfile_ge_one
statement:
theorem rootProfile_ge_one {u v : ℝ} (hu : 0 < u) (hv : v < 0) (z : ℝ) :
    1 ≤ rootProfile u v z

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.rootProfile_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem rootProfile_hasDerivAt (u v z : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (rootProfile u v)
      ((u * (Real.exp (v * z) * v) - v * (Real.exp (u * z) * u)) / (u - v)) z

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.rootProfile_ode
statement:
theorem rootProfile_ode {u v β ρ : ℝ}
    (hu : u ^ 2 + β * u - ρ = 0) (hv : v ^ 2 + β * v - ρ = 0) (z : ℝ) :
    deriv (deriv (rootProfile u v)) z + β * deriv (rootProfile u v) z -
      ρ * rootProfile u v z = 0

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.rootProfile_smooth
statement: theorem rootProfile_smooth (u v : ℝ) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (rootProfile u v)

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.rootProfile_zero
statement: theorem rootProfile_zero {u v : ℝ} (huv : u ≠ v) : rootProfile u v 0 = 1

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.roots_equations
statement:
theorem roots_equations {β ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) :
    positiveRoot β ρ ^ 2 + β * positiveRoot β ρ - ρ = 0 ∧
    negativeRoot β ρ ^ 2 + β * negativeRoot β ρ - ρ = 0

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.roots_signs
statement:
theorem roots_signs {β ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    0 < positiveRoot β ρ ∧ negativeRoot β ρ < 0

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.roots_sum_product
statement:
theorem roots_sum_product {β ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) :
    positiveRoot β ρ + negativeRoot β ρ = -β ∧
      positiveRoot β ρ * negativeRoot β ρ = -ρ

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.slope_gap_crosses_up
statement:
theorem slope_gap_crosses_up (hα : α = k - h - 1)
    (hf : ProfileData (α - c) k f) (hg : ProfileData (α + 2 - c) h g)
    {z : ℝ} (hzero : logSlope f z - logSlope g z - 1 = 0) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => logSlope f y - logSlope g y - 1) c z

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.slope_gap_initial
statement:
theorem slope_gap_initial (hf : ProfileData (α - c) k f)
    (hg : ProfileData (α + 2 - c) h g) :
    logSlope f 0 - logSlope g 0 - 1 = -1

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.straightPrice_dominates
statement:
theorem straightPrice_dominates {k h c d x t : ℝ}
    (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hhk : h ≤ k) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hd : d ≤ 0)
    (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hx : x ≤ 0) :
    1 - Real.exp x ≤ straightPrice k h c d x t

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.straightPrice_equation
statement:
theorem straightPrice_equation {k h : ℝ} (hk : 0 < k) (hh : 0 ≤ h) (c d x t : ℝ) :
    deriv (straightPrice k h c d x) t =
      deriv (deriv (fun y => straightPrice k h c d y t)) x +
        (k - h - 1) * deriv (fun y => straightPrice k h c d y t) x -
          k * straightPrice k h c d x t

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.straightPrice_fit
statement:
theorem straightPrice_fit {k h : ℝ} (hk : 0 < k) (hh : 0 ≤ h) (c d t : ℝ) :
    straightPrice k h c d (d - c * t) t = 1 - Real.exp (d - c * t) ∧
    HasDerivAt (fun x => straightPrice k h c d x t)
      (-Real.exp (d - c * t)) (d - c * t)

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.straightPrice_liu_range_dominates
statement:
theorem straightPrice_liu_range_dominates {k h c d x t : ℝ}
    (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hliu : h + 1 ≤ k) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hd : d ≤ 0)
    (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hx : x ≤ 0) :
    1 - Real.exp x ≤ straightPrice k h c d x t

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.straightPrice_zero_dividend
statement:
theorem straightPrice_zero_dividend (k c d x t : ℝ) :
    straightPrice k 0 c d x t = profile (k - 1 - c) k (x + c * t - d) - Real.exp x

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.straightPrice_zero_dividend_dominates
MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.dividend_curvature_of_comparison_inputs
statement:
theorem dividend_curvature_of_comparison_inputs {k h : ℝ}
    {p : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ} {b : ℝ → ℝ} (hp : DividendPutSolution k h p b)
    (hinterval : ∀ c d : ℝ, 0 < c → d < 0 → ∀ t, 0 < t →
      OrdConnected {x | b t < x ∧ 0 < straightDifference p k h c d x t}) :
    ∀ t, 0 < t → 0 ≤ deriv (deriv b) t

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.stock_curvature_of_comparison_inputs
statement:
theorem stock_curvature_of_comparison_inputs {k h : ℝ}
    {p : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ} {b : ℝ → ℝ} (hp : DividendPutSolution k h p b)
    (hspeed : ∀ t, 0 < t → deriv b t < 0)
    (hinterval : ∀ c d : ℝ, 0 < c → d < 0 → ∀ t, 0 < t →
      OrdConnected {x | b t < x ∧ 0 < straightDifference p k h c d x t})
    {E σ expiry T : ℝ} (hE : 0 < E) (hσ : 0 < σ) (hT : T < expiry) :
    0 < deriv (deriv (stockBoundary E σ expiry b)) T

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.zeroDividend_curvature_of_comparison_inputs
statement:
theorem zeroDividend_curvature_of_comparison_inputs {k : ℝ}
    {p : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ} {b : ℝ → ℝ} (hp : NormalizedPutSolution k p b)
    (hinterval : ∀ c d : ℝ, 0 < c → d < 0 → ∀ t, 0 < t →
      OrdConnected {x | b t < x ∧ 0 < straightDifference p k 0 c d x t}) :
    ∀ t, 0 < t → 0 ≤ deriv (deriv b) t

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.normalizedDrift_bounded
statement:
theorem normalizedDrift_bounded {β ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (α c d : ℝ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ x t,
      |normalizedDrift α c d (profile β ρ) x t| ≤ C ∧
      |deriv (fun y => normalizedDrift α c d (profile β ρ) y t) x| ≤ C ∧
      |deriv (normalizedDrift α c d (profile β ρ) x) t| ≤ C

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.normalizedDrift_eq
statement:
theorem normalizedDrift_eq (α c d : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x t : ℝ) :
    normalizedDrift α c d f x t = α + 2 * deriv f (x + c * t - d) / f (x + c * t - d)

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.normalizedDrift_hasDeriv_t
statement:
theorem normalizedDrift_hasDeriv_t {β ρ : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ProfileData β ρ f) (α c d x t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (normalizedDrift α c d f x)
      (2 * c * deriv (logSlope f) (x + c * t - d)) t

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.normalizedDrift_hasDeriv_x
statement:
theorem normalizedDrift_hasDeriv_x {β ρ : ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ProfileData β ρ f) (α c d x t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => normalizedDrift α c d f y t)
      (2 * deriv (logSlope f) (x + c * t - d)) x

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.profile_slope_and_deriv_bounded
statement:
theorem profile_slope_and_deriv_bounded {β ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∀ z,
      |logSlope (profile β ρ) z| ≤ B ∧ |deriv (logSlope (profile β ρ)) z| ≤ B

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.profile_slope_bounds
statement:
theorem profile_slope_bounds {β ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (z : ℝ) :
    negativeRoot β ρ < logSlope (profile β ρ) z ∧
      logSlope (profile β ρ) z < positiveRoot β ρ

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.rootProfile_slope_bounds
statement:
theorem rootProfile_slope_bounds {u v : ℝ} (hu : 0 < u) (hv : v < 0) (z : ℝ) :
    v < logSlope (rootProfile u v) z ∧ logSlope (rootProfile u v) z < u

MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.lineDifference_continuousOn
statement:
theorem lineDifference_continuousOn (hp : ContinuousBoundaryPutSolution k h p b) :
    ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => lineDifference p k h c d z.1 z.2) {z | 0 ≤ z.2}

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.lineDifference_equation
statement:
theorem lineDifference_equation (hp : ContinuousBoundaryPutSolution k h p b) {y t : ℝ}
    (ht : 0 < t) (hx : b t < y + (d - c * t)) :
    deriv (lineDifference p k h c d y) t =
      deriv (deriv (fun z => lineDifference p k h c d z t)) y +
        (k - h - 1 - c + 2 * logSlope (profile (k - h - 1 - c) k) y) *
          deriv (fun z => lineDifference p k h c d z t) y

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.lineDifference_fit
statement:
theorem lineDifference_fit (hp : ContinuousBoundaryPutSolution k h p b) {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T)
    (hcontact : b T = d - c * T) :
    lineDifference p k h c d 0 T = 0 ∧
      HasDerivWithinAt (fun y => lineDifference p k h c d y T) 0 (Ici 0) 0

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.lineDifference_no_positive_rectangle
statement:
theorem lineDifference_no_positive_rectangle (hp : ContinuousBoundaryPutSolution k h p b)
    {L a T : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (ha : 0 < a) (haT : a ≤ T)
    (hline : ∀ t ∈ Icc a T, b t ≤ d - c * t)
    (hcontact : b T = d - c * T)
    (hbottom : ∀ y ∈ Icc 0 L, 0 < lineDifference p k h c d y a)
    (hright : ∀ t ∈ Icc a T, 0 < lineDifference p k h c d L t) : False

statement:
theorem lineDifference_on_line_nonneg (hp : ContinuousBoundaryPutSolution k h p b) {t : ℝ}

statement:
theorem straightDifference_le_of_initial_le (hp : ContinuousBoundaryPutSolution k h p b)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hd : d ≤ 0) {a ε : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)

statement:

    (hc : 0 < c) (hd : d ≤ 0) {a T x : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (haT : a ≤ T)
    (hx : b T ≤ x) (hpos : 0 < straightDifference p k h c d x T) :

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.zeroDividend_le_of_initial_le
statement:
theorem zeroDividend_le_of_initial_le {k c d : ℝ} {p : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ} {b : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hp : NormalizedPutSolution k p b) (hc : 0 < c) (hd : d ≤ 0)
    {a ε : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hinit : ∀ x, b a ≤ x →
      normalizedDifference p (profile (k - 1 - c) k) (fun _ => 1) c d x a ≤ ε)

    normalizedDifference p (profile (k - 1 - c) k) (fun _ => 1) c d x T ≤ ε

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.initialDifference_eq_iff_ratio_eq
statement:
theorem initialDifference_eq_iff_ratio_eq (hf : ProfileData (α - c) k f) (d x y : ℝ) :
    initialDifference f g d x = initialDifference f g d y ↔
      initialRatio f g (x - d) = initialRatio f g (y - d)

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.initialDifference_eq_price
statement:
theorem initialDifference_eq_price (hf : ProfileData (α - c) k f)
    (d x : ℝ) : initialDifference f g d x = (0 - price f g c d x 0) / f (x - d)

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.initialDifference_eq_ratio
statement:
theorem initialDifference_eq_ratio (hf : ProfileData (α - c) k f)
    (d x : ℝ) :
    initialDifference f g d x = -1 + Real.exp d / initialRatio f g (x - d)

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.initialDifference_hasDeriv
statement:
theorem initialDifference_hasDeriv (hf : ProfileData (α - c) k f)
    (hg : ProfileData (α + 2 - c) h g) (d x : ℝ) :

theorem normalizedDifference_exp_bound {p : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ} {f g : ℝ → ℝ}
    {A lam μ c d x t : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A) (hlam : 0 < lam) (hgap : μ + 1 < lam)
    (hf : ∀ z, A * Real.exp (lam * z) ≤ f z)
    (hg0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ g z) (hg : ∀ z, 0 ≤ z → g z ≤ Real.exp (μ * z))
    (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hd : d ≤ 0) (hx : 0 ≤ x) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (hp0 : 0 ≤ p x t) (hp1 : p x t ≤ 1) :
    |normalizedDifference p f g c d x t + 1| ≤
      A⁻¹ * (Real.exp (-lam * x) + Real.exp (-(lam - μ - 1) * x))

theorem deriv2_stockBoundary (E σ expiry : ℝ) {s ds : ℝ → ℝ} {dds T : ℝ}

theorem constant_shift_equation {v : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ} {β x t ε : ℝ}
    (hvx : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (fun y => v y t) x)
    (hvt : DifferentiableAt ℝ (v x) t)
    (heq : deriv (v x) t = deriv (deriv (fun y => v y t)) x +
      β * deriv (fun y => v y t) x) :
    deriv (fun s => v x s - ε) t =
      deriv (deriv (fun y => v y t - ε)) x + β * deriv (fun y => v y t - ε) x

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.deriv2_mul_at
statement:
theorem deriv2_mul_at {F G : ℝ → ℝ} {x : ℝ}
    (hF : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 F x) (hG : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 G x) :
    deriv (deriv (fun y => F y * G y)) x =
      deriv (deriv F) x * G x + 2 * deriv F x * deriv G x + F x * deriv (deriv G) x

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.gauge_equation
statement:
theorem gauge_equation {u : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ} {x t : ℝ}
    (hf : ProfileData (α - c) k f)
    (hux : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (fun y => u y t) x)
    (hut : DifferentiableAt ℝ (u x) t)
    (heq : deriv (u x) t = deriv (deriv (fun y => u y t)) x +
      α * deriv (fun y => u y t) x - k * u x t) :
    deriv (gauge u f c d x) t =
      deriv (deriv (fun y => gauge u f c d y t)) x +
        (α + 2 * deriv f (x + c * t - d) / f (x + c * t - d)) *
          deriv (fun y => gauge u f c d y t) x

MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.Comparison.normalizedDifference_equation
statement:
theorem normalizedDifference_equation {h : ℝ} {p : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ} {b g : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hp : ContinuousBoundaryPutSolution k h p b)
    (hf : ProfileData (k - h - 1 - c) k f)
    (hg : ProfileData (k - h - 1 + 2 - c) h g)
    {x t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (hx : b t < x) :

theorem normalizedDifference_shifted_equation {h ε : ℝ}

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Boundary.movingLineTransform_equation
statement:
theorem movingLineTransform_equation {V D : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ} {c d y t : ℝ}
    (hV : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => V z.1 z.2) (y + (d - c * t),t))
    (heq : deriv (V (y + (d - c * t))) t =
      deriv (deriv (fun x => V x t)) (y + (d - c * t)) +
        D (y + (d - c * t)) t * deriv (fun x => V x t) (y + (d - c * t))) :
    deriv (movingLineTransform V c d y) t =
      deriv (deriv (fun z => movingLineTransform V c d z t)) y +
        (D (y + (d - c * t)) t - c) * deriv (fun z => movingLineTransform V c d z t) y

    {k h T : ℝ} {p U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ} {b L R : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hp : DividendPutSolution k h p b)
    (hL : Continuous L) (hR : Continuous R)
    (hQ : IsCompact (twoSidedStrip L R T))
    (hUc : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => U z.1 z.2) (twoSidedStrip L R T))
    (_hUs : ∀ t, 0 < t → t ≤ T → ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun x => U x t))
    (hUj : ∀ x t, 0 < t → t ≤ T → L t < x → x < R t →
      ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => U z.1 z.2) (x,t))
    (hsub : ∀ x t, 0 < t → t ≤ T → L t < x → x < R t →
      deriv (U x) t ≤ dividendSpatialOperator k h (fun y => U y t) x)
    (hinit : ∀ x, L 0 ≤ x → x ≤ R 0 → U x 0 ≤ p x 0)
    (hleft : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → t ≤ T → U (L t) t ≤ p (L t) t)
    (hright : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → t ≤ T → U (R t) t ≤ p (R t) t) :
    ∀ z ∈ twoSidedStrip L R T, U z.1 z.2 ≤ p z.1 z.2

    (hL : 0 < L) (haT : a ≤ T) (hη : 0 < η) (hlam : 0 < lam)
    (hu : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => u z.1 z.2) (movingStrip (fun _ => 0) L a T))
    (hux : ∀ x t, 0 < x → x < L → a < t → t ≤ T → ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (fun y => u y t) x)
    (hut : ∀ x t, 0 < x → x < L → a < t → t ≤ T → DifferentiableAt ℝ (u x) t)
    (hpde : ∀ x t, 0 < x → x < L → a < t → t ≤ T →
      deriv (deriv (fun y => u y t)) x + D x t * deriv (fun y => u y t) x ≤ deriv (u x) t)
    (hD : ∀ x t, 0 < x → x < L → a < t → t ≤ T → 0 ≤ lam + D x t)
    (hbottom : ∀ x, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ L → expBarrier η lam x ≤ u x a)
    (hleft : ∀ t, a ≤ t → t ≤ T → 0 ≤ u 0 t)
    (hright : ∀ t, a ≤ t → t ≤ T → expBarrier η lam L ≤ u L t)
    (hzero : u 0 T = 0) (hd : HasDerivWithinAt (fun x => u x T) v (Ici 0) 0) :
    η * lam ≤ v

statement:
theorem parabolic_three_point_bound {U D : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ} {b : ℝ → ℝ} {R T : ℝ}
    (hb : ContinuousOn b (Icc 0 T)) (hbR : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, b t ≤ R)
    (hU : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => U z.1 z.2) (movingStrip b R 0 T))
    (hs : ∀ x t, 0 < t → t ≤ T → b t < x → x < R →
      ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => U z.1 z.2) (x,t))
    (hpde : ∀ x t, 0 < t → t ≤ T → b t < x → x < R →
      deriv (U x) t = deriv (deriv (fun y => U y t)) x + D x t * deriv (fun y => U y t) x)
    (hleft : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → t ≤ T → U (b t) t ≤ 0)
    (hright : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → t ≤ T → U R t ≤ 0)
    (hinit : ∀ x y z, b 0 ≤ x → x ≤ y → y ≤ z → z ≤ R →
      min (U x 0) (U z 0) ≤ max (U y 0) 0)
    {x y z t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) (htT : t ≤ T)

theorem positive_rectangle_of_positive_bottom {U D : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ} {L a T M : ℝ}
    (hL : 0 < L) (haT : a ≤ T)
    (hU : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => U z.1 z.2) (movingStrip (fun _ => 0) L a T))
    (hs : ∀ x t, 0 < x → x < L → a < t → t ≤ T →
      ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => U z.1 z.2) (x,t))
    (hpde : ∀ x t, 0 < x → x < L → a < t → t ≤ T →
      deriv (deriv (fun y => U y t)) x + D x t * deriv (fun y => U y t) x ≤ deriv (U x) t)
    (hD : ∀ x t, 0 < x → x < L → a < t → t ≤ T → |D x t| ≤ M)
    (hbottom : ∀ x ∈ Icc 0 L, 0 < U x a)
    (hleft : ∀ t ∈ Icc a T, 0 ≤ U 0 t)

      deriv (U (x+(d-c*t))) t = deriv (deriv (fun y => U y t)) (x+(d-c*t)) +

    (hD : ∀ x t, 0 < x → x < L → a < t → t ≤ T → |D (x+(d-c*t)) t| ≤ M)
    (hbottom : ∀ x ∈ Icc 0 L, 0 < U (x+(d-c*a)) a)
    (hnonneg : ∀ x t, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ L → a ≤ t → t ≤ T → 0 ≤ U (x+(d-c*t)) t) :

    {k h a T C : ℝ} {p U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ} {b : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hp : DividendPutSolution k h p b) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hUc : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => U z.1 z.2) {z | z.2 ∈ Icc a T})
    (hUb : ∀ x t, t ∈ Icc a T → U x t ≤ C)
    (hUj : ∀ x t, a < t → t ≤ T → p x t < U x t →
      ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => U z.1 z.2) (x,t))
    (hsub : ∀ x t, a < t → t ≤ T → p x t < U x t →
      deriv (U x) t ≤ dividendSpatialOperator k h (fun y => U y t) x)
    (hinit : ∀ x, U x a ≤ p x a) :
    ∀ x t, t ∈ Icc a T → U x t ≤ p x t

statement:
theorem DividendPutSolution.obstacle_comparison_window
    {k h a T L R : ℝ} {p U : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ} {b : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hp : DividendPutSolution k h p b) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hUc : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => U z.1 z.2) (Icc L R ×ˢ Icc a T))
    (hUj : ∀ x t, a < t → t ≤ T → L < x → x < R →
      p x t < U x t → ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => U z.1 z.2) (x,t))
    (hsub : ∀ x t, a < t → t ≤ T → L < x → x < R →
      p x t < U x t → deriv (U x) t ≤ dividendSpatialOperator k h (fun y => U y t) x)
    (hinit : ∀ x ∈ Icc L R, U x a ≤ p x a)
    (hleft : ∀ t ∈ Icc a T, U L t ≤ p L t)
    (hright : ∀ t ∈ Icc a T, U R t ≤ p R t) :
    ∀ z ∈ Icc L R ×ˢ Icc a T, U z.1 z.2 ≤ p z.1 z.2

theorem brownianPriceKernel_deriv_space (p : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (K r q σ x₀ T t w : ℝ) :
    deriv (fun y => brownianPriceKernel p K r q σ x₀ T t y) w =
      Real.exp (-r*t)*K*σ*deriv (fun x => p x (σ^2/2*(T-t))) (x₀+(r-q-σ^2/2)*t+σ*w)

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Stopping.brownianPriceKernel_hasDeriv_time
statement:
theorem brownianPriceKernel_hasDeriv_time {p : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ} {K r q σ x₀ T t w : ℝ}
    (hp : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => p z.1 z.2)
      (x₀+(r-q-σ^2/2)*t+σ*w,σ^2/2*(T-t))) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => brownianPriceKernel p K r q σ x₀ T s w)
      (Real.exp (-r*t)*K*((r-q-σ^2/2)*
        deriv (fun x => p x (σ^2/2*(T-t))) (x₀+(r-q-σ^2/2)*t+σ*w) -
        σ^2/2*deriv (p (x₀+(r-q-σ^2/2)*t+σ*w)) (σ^2/2*(T-t)) -
        r*p (x₀+(r-q-σ^2/2)*t+σ*w) (σ^2/2*(T-t)))) t

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Stopping.brownianPriceKernel_heat_equation
statement:
theorem brownianPriceKernel_heat_equation {p : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ} {b : ℝ → ℝ}
    {K r q σ x₀ T t w : ℝ}
    (hp : DividendPutSolution (normalizedRate r σ) (normalizedRate q σ) p b)
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (ht : t < T)
    (hx : b (σ^2/2*(T-t)) < x₀+(r-q-σ^2/2)*t+σ*w) :
    deriv (fun s => brownianPriceKernel p K r q σ x₀ T s w) t +
      (1/2)*deriv (deriv (fun y => brownianPriceKernel p K r q σ x₀ T t y)) w = 0

    {𝓕 : Filtration ℝ≥0 ‹MeasurableSpace Ω›} {W : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ}
    {k h K r q σ S : ℝ} {p : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ} {b : ℝ → ℝ} {T : ℝ≥0}
    (hp : DividendPutSolution k h p b) (hW : Measurable W.uncurry)
    (hpaths : ∀ ω, Continuous (fun t => W t ω)) (hzero : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, W 0 ω = 0)
    (hK : 0 < K) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hS : 0 < S)
    (hsuper : Supermartingale (classicalCandidate W K r q σ S p T) 𝓕 P)
    (θ : BoundedRule 𝓕 T)
    (hcontact : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, classicalCandidate W K r q σ S p T (θ.time ω) ω =
      putReward W K r q σ S θ.time ω)

      (min t (θ.time ω)) ω) 𝓕 P) :

    (hc₀ : HasCompactSupport (g₀.1 : ℝ → ℝ)) (hc₁ : HasCompactSupport (g₁.1 : ℝ → ℝ)) :

statement:
theorem exists_halfLine_heat_boundary_solution {g : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hg : Continuous g) (hc : HasCompactSupport g) {a : ℝ}
    (hstart : ∀ t, t ≤ a → g t = 0) :

      (∀ t, V (0,t) = g t) ∧

      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ V {z | 0 < z.1} ∧

name: MathFin.BlackScholes.AmericanPut.Stopping.heatBoundaryKernel_smoothAt

    (h₁ : Continuous g₁) (hc₁ : HasCompactSupport g₁) {a L : ℝ}
    (hL : 0 < L) (hs₀ : ∀ t, t ≤ a → g₀ t = 0) (hs₁ : ∀ t, t ≤ a → g₁ t = 0) (T : ℝ) :
    ∃ V : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, Continuous V ∧
      (∀ x t, t ≤ a → V (x,t) = 0) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc a T, V (0,t) = g₀ t) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Icc a T, V (L,t) = g₁ t) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ V {z | 0 < z.1 ∧ z.1 < L} ∧
      ∀ x, 0 < x → x < L → ∀ t, deriv (fun s => V (x,s)) t =
        (1/2)*deriv (deriv (fun y => V (y,t))) x

name: MathFin.asianGeom_driver_hasLaw

theorem asianGeom_driver_hasLaw (hB : IsPreBrownianReal B μ) (T : ℝ≥0)
    {s t : ℝ≥0} (hst : s ≤ t) (hsT : s ≤ T) (htT : t ≤ T) :
    HasLaw (fun ω ↦ (B s ω + B t ω) / 2)
      (gaussianReal 0 ((3 * (s : ℝ) + t) / 4).toNNReal) μ

name: MathFin.geomAsianN_call_price
statement:
theorem geomAsianN_call_price (hB : IsPreBrownianReal B μ) (T : ℝ≥0)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (τ : Fin n → ℝ≥0) (hτT : ∀ i, τ i ≤ T)
    (S₀ K r σ Tmat : ℝ) (hS₀ : 0 < S₀) (hK : 0 < K) (hσ : 0 < σ) (hTmat : 0 < Tmat)
    (hV : 0 < geomAsianVar τ) :
    ∫ ω, Real.exp (-r * Tmat) *
        max ((∏ i, (S₀ * Real.exp ((r - σ ^ 2 / 2) * (τ i : ℝ) + σ * B (τ i) ω)) ^ ((n : ℝ)⁻¹))
          - K) 0 ∂μ
      = geomAsianEffSpot S₀ r σ Tmat τ *
          Phi (bsd1 (geomAsianEffSpot S₀ r σ Tmat τ) K r (geomAsianEffVol σ Tmat τ) Tmat)
        - K * Real.exp (-r * Tmat) *
          Phi (bsd2 (geomAsianEffSpot S₀ r σ Tmat τ) K r (geomAsianEffVol σ Tmat τ) Tmat)

name: MathFin.geomAsianN_driver_hasLaw

    HasLaw (fun ω ↦ (∑ i, B (τ i) ω) / n)

name: MathFin.bachelier_call_formula
statement:
theorem bachelier_call_formula {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω}
    {Q : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
    {S_0 K σ T : ℝ} {Z : Ω → ℝ}
    (h : BachelierHyp Q S_0 K σ T Z) :
    ∫ ω, max (bachelierTerminal S_0 σ T (Z ω) - K) 0 ∂Q
      = (S_0 - K) * Phi (bachelierD S_0 K σ T) +
        σ * Real.sqrt T * gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (bachelierD S_0 K σ T)

MathFin.bs_call_formula
statement:
theorem bs_call_formula {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω}
    {Q : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
    {S_0 K r σ T : ℝ} {Z : Ω → ℝ}
    (h : BSCallHyp Q S_0 K r σ T Z) :
    ∫ ω, Real.exp (-r * T) * max (bsTerminal S_0 r σ T (Z ω) - K) 0 ∂Q
      = S_0 * Phi (bsd1 S_0 K r σ T) -
        K * Real.exp (-r * T) * Phi (bsd2 S_0 K r σ T)

name: MathFin.bsd2_eq
statement:
lemma bsd2_eq {S_0 K r σ T : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (hT : 0 < T) :

name: MathFin.chooserPrice_expanded
statement:
theorem chooserPrice_expanded (S_0 K r σ T t_1 : ℝ) :
    chooserPrice S_0 K r σ T t_1 =
      (S_0 * Phi (bsd1 S_0 K r σ T) -
        K * Real.exp (-(r * T)) * Phi (bsd2 S_0 K r σ T)) +
      ((K * Real.exp (-(r * (T - t_1)))) * Real.exp (-(r * t_1)) *
          Phi (-(bsd2 S_0 (K * Real.exp (-(r * (T - t_1)))) r σ t_1)) -
        S_0 * Phi (-(bsd1 S_0 (K * Real.exp (-(r * (T - t_1)))) r σ t_1)))

name: MathFin.chooser_integral_decomp
statement:
theorem chooser_integral_decomp
    {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} (Q : Measure Ω)
    (C P S : Ω → ℝ) (K_disc : ℝ)
    (hPCP : ∀ ω, C ω - P ω = S ω - K_disc)
    (hint_C : Integrable C Q)
    (hint_put : Integrable (fun ω ↦ max 0 (K_disc - S ω)) Q) :
    ∫ ω, max (C ω) (P ω) ∂Q =
      (∫ ω, C ω ∂Q) + ∫ ω, max 0 (K_disc - S ω) ∂Q

name: MathFin.bs_asset_or_nothing_formula
statement:
theorem bs_asset_or_nothing_formula {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω}
    {Q : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
    {S_0 K r σ T : ℝ} {Z : Ω → ℝ}
    (h : BSCallHyp Q S_0 K r σ T Z) :
    ∫ ω, Real.exp (-r * T) *
        (Set.Ioi K).indicator
          (fun s ↦ s) (bsTerminal S_0 r σ T (Z ω)) ∂Q
      = S_0 * Phi (bsd1 S_0 K r σ T)

name: MathFin.bs_call_eq_asset_minus_K_cash
statement:
theorem bs_call_eq_asset_minus_K_cash {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω}
    {Q : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
    {S_0 K r σ T : ℝ} {Z : Ω → ℝ}
    (h : BSCallHyp Q S_0 K r σ T Z) :
    (∫ ω, Real.exp (-r * T) * max (bsTerminal S_0 r σ T (Z ω) - K) 0 ∂Q)
      =
    (∫ ω, Real.exp (-r * T) *
        (Set.Ioi K).indicator
          (fun s ↦ s) (bsTerminal S_0 r σ T (Z ω)) ∂Q)
    - K *
    (∫ ω, Real.exp (-r * T) *
        (Set.Ioi K).indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) (bsTerminal S_0 r σ T (Z ω)) ∂Q)

name: MathFin.bs_cash_or_nothing_formula
statement:
theorem bs_cash_or_nothing_formula {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω}

        (Set.Ioi K).indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) (bsTerminal S_0 r σ T (Z ω)) ∂Q
      = Real.exp (-r * T) * Phi (bsd2 S_0 K r σ T)

name: MathFin.hasDerivAt_bsAssetDigital_S
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_bsAssetDigital_S {K r σ : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (hσ : 0 < σ)

      (Phi (bsd1 S K r σ τ) + gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (bsd1 S K r σ τ) / (σ * Real.sqrt τ)) S

name: MathFin.hasDerivAt_bsAssetDigital_SS
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_bsAssetDigital_SS {K r σ : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (hσ : 0 < σ)
    {S τ : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    HasDerivAt
      (fun s ↦ Phi (bsd1 s K r σ τ) +
        gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (bsd1 s K r σ τ) / (σ * Real.sqrt τ))
      (-(gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (bsd1 S K r σ τ) *

lemma hasDerivAt_bsAssetDigital_r (S K σ : ℝ) (hσ : 0 < σ) {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ) (r : ℝ) :

name: MathFin.hasDerivAt_bsAssetDigital_sigma
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_bsAssetDigital_sigma (S K r : ℝ) {σ τ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (hτ : 0 < τ) :

name: MathFin.hasDerivAt_bsAssetDigital_tau
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_bsAssetDigital_tau (S K r σ : ℝ) (hσ : 0 < σ) {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ) :

name: MathFin.hasDerivAt_bsCashDigital_SS
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_bsCashDigital_SS {K r σ : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (hσ : 0 < σ)

name: MathFin.hasDerivAt_bsCashDigital_r
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_bsCashDigital_r (S K σ : ℝ) (hσ : 0 < σ) {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ) (r : ℝ) :

name: MathFin.hasDerivAt_bsCashDigital_sigma

lemma hasDerivAt_bsCashDigital_sigma (S K : ℝ) {r σ τ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (hτ : 0 < τ) :

name: MathFin.hasDerivAt_bsCashDigital_tau
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_bsCashDigital_tau (S K r σ : ℝ) (hσ : 0 < σ) {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t ↦ bsCashDigital K r σ S t)
      (-r * Real.exp (-(r * τ)) * Phi (bsd2 S K r σ τ) +

name: MathFin.bs_dividends_call_formula

theorem bs_dividends_call_formula {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω}

      = S_0 * Real.exp (-(q * T)) * Phi (bsd1 S_0 K (r - q) σ T)

name: MathFin.hasDerivAt_bsVDiv_r

lemma hasDerivAt_bsVDiv_r {K q σ τ : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (hσ : 0 < σ) (hτ : 0 < τ)
    {S : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S) (r : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun r' ↦ bsVDiv K r' q σ S τ)
      (K * τ * Real.exp (-(r * τ)) * Phi (bsd2 S K (r - q) σ τ)) r

name: MathFin.hasDerivAt_bsVDiv_sigma
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_bsVDiv_sigma {K r q : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K)
    {S σ τ : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S) (hσ : 0 < σ) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s ↦ bsVDiv K r q s S τ)
      (Real.exp (-(q * τ)) * S * gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (bsd1 S K (r - q) σ τ)
        * Real.sqrt τ) σ

name: MathFin.hasDerivAt_bsVDiv_tau
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_bsVDiv_tau {K r q σ : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (hσ : 0 < σ)
    {S τ : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t ↦ bsVDiv K r q σ S t)
      (-(q * bsVDiv K r q σ S τ) +
        Real.exp (-(q * τ)) *
          (σ * S * gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (bsd1 S K (r - q) σ τ) / (2 * Real.sqrt τ)
            + (r - q) * K * Real.exp (-((r - q) * τ)) * Phi (bsd2 S K (r - q) σ τ))) τ

    {L₁ L₂ : Ω → ℝ} {σ₁ σ₂ ρ T : ℝ}

    (hS_0 : 0 < S_0) (hK : 0 < K) (hT : 0 < T) (hk : -1 < k) :

          * bsV K (mertonRate r k T Λ n) (mertonVol σ δ T n) S_0 T

theorem newtonSeq_error_le_geometric
    (hroot : f r = 0) (hm0 : 0 < m) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hd : ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc (r - δ) (r + δ), HasDerivAt f (f' y) y)
    (hlip : ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc (r - δ) (r + δ), ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc (r - δ) (r + δ),
      |f' y - f' w| ≤ L * |y - w|)
    (hm : ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc (r - δ) (r + δ), m ≤ |f' y|)
    (hx₀ : |x₀ - r| ≤ δ) (hbasin : L * δ ≤ m) :
    ∀ n, |newtonSeq f f' x₀ n - r| ≤ (1 / 2) ^ n * |x₀ - r|

      |f' y - f' w| ≤ L * |y - w|)
    (hm : ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc (r - δ) (r + δ), m ≤ |f' y|)

name: MathFin.bs_identity
statement:
lemma bs_identity {S K r σ τ : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S) (hK : 0 < K) (hσ : 0 < σ) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    S * gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (bsd1 S K r σ τ)
      = K * Real.exp (-(r * τ)) * gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (bsd2 S K r σ τ)

name: MathFin.bs_pde_holds
statement:
theorem bs_pde_holds {K T r σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ)
    {S t : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S) (ht_T : t < T) :
    -(σ * S * gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (bsd1 S K r σ (T - t)) / (2 * Real.sqrt (T - t))
      + r * K * Real.exp (-(r * (T - t))) * Phi (bsd2 S K r σ (T - t))) +
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) * σ ^ 2 * S ^ 2 *
      (gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (bsd1 S K r σ (T - t)) / (S * σ * Real.sqrt (T - t))) +
    r * S * Phi (bsd1 S K r σ (T - t)) -
    r * bsV K r σ S (T - t) = 0

name: MathFin.bsV_eq_discount_feynmanU
statement:
theorem bsV_eq_discount_feynmanU {K r σ S τ : ℝ}
    (hS : 0 < S) (hK : 0 < K) (hσ : 0 < σ) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    bsV K r σ S τ = Real.exp (-(r * τ))
      * feynmanU (fun ξ ↦ max (Real.exp ξ - K) 0) (σ ^ 2 * τ)
          (Real.log S + (r - σ ^ 2 / 2) * τ)

name: MathFin.bsV_eq_feynmanU
statement:
theorem bsV_eq_feynmanU {K r σ S τ : ℝ}
    (hS : 0 < S) (hK : 0 < K) (hσ : 0 < σ) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    bsV K r σ S τ =
      FeynmanKacHeatEquation.feynmanU
        (fun ξ ↦ Real.exp (-(r * τ)) * max (Real.exp ξ - K) 0)
        (σ ^ 2 * τ)
        (Real.log S + (r - σ ^ 2 / 2) * τ)

name: MathFin.bsV_satisfies_bs_pde_via_feynmanKac
statement:
theorem bsV_satisfies_bs_pde_via_feynmanKac {K r σ : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (hσ : 0 < σ)
    {S τ : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    ∃ Vτ VS VSS : ℝ,
      HasDerivAt (fun τ' ↦ bsV K r σ S τ') Vτ τ ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun S' ↦ bsV K r σ S' τ) VS S ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun S' ↦ deriv (fun S'' ↦ bsV K r σ S'' τ) S') VSS S ∧
      -Vτ + (1 / 2) * σ ^ 2 * S ^ 2 * VSS + r * S * VS - r * bsV K r σ S τ = 0

name: MathFin.bs_power_call_formula
statement:
theorem bs_power_call_formula
    {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω}
    {Q : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
    {S_0 K r σ T : ℝ} {Z : Ω → ℝ}
    (a : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hK : 0 < K)
    (h : BSCallHyp Q S_0 K r σ T Z) :
    ∫ ω, Real.exp (-r * T) *
        max (bsPowerTerminal S_0 r σ T a (Z ω) - K) 0 ∂Q =
      bsPowerEffectiveSpot S_0 r σ T a *
        Phi (bsd1 (bsPowerEffectiveSpot S_0 r σ T a) K r ((a : ℝ) * σ) T) -
      K * Real.exp (-r * T) *
        Phi (bsd2 (bsPowerEffectiveSpot S_0 r σ T a) K r ((a : ℝ) * σ) T)

theorem noArbBox

name: MathFin.hasDerivAt_bsP_S
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_bsP_S {K r σ : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (hσ : 0 < σ)
    {S τ : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s ↦ bsP K r σ s τ) (Phi (bsd1 S K r σ τ) - 1) S

name: MathFin.hasDerivAt_bsP_SS
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_bsP_SS {K r σ : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (hσ : 0 < σ)
    {S τ : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s ↦ Phi (bsd1 s K r σ τ) - 1)
      (gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (bsd1 S K r σ τ) / (S * σ * Real.sqrt τ)) S

name: MathFin.hasDerivAt_bsP_r
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_bsP_r {K σ τ : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (hσ : 0 < σ) (hτ : 0 < τ)
    {S : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S) (r : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun r' ↦ bsP K r' σ S τ)
      (-(K * τ * Real.exp (-(r * τ)) * Phi (-bsd2 S K r σ τ))) r

name: MathFin.hasDerivAt_bsP_sigma
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_bsP_sigma {K r : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K)
    {S σ τ : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S) (hσ : 0 < σ) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s ↦ bsP K r s S τ)
      (S * gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (bsd1 S K r σ τ) * Real.sqrt τ) σ

name: MathFin.hasDerivAt_bsP_tau
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_bsP_tau {K r σ : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (hσ : 0 < σ)
    {S τ : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t ↦ bsP K r σ S t)
      (σ * S * gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (bsd1 S K r σ τ) / (2 * Real.sqrt τ)
        - r * K * Real.exp (-(r * τ)) * Phi (-bsd2 S K r σ τ)) τ

name: MathFin.hasDerivAt_bsP_KK
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_bsP_KK {S r σ : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S) (hσ : 0 < σ)
    {K τ : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun k ↦ Real.exp (-(r * τ)) * Phi (-bsd2 S k r σ τ))
      (Real.exp (-(r * τ)) *
        gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (bsd2 S K r σ τ) /
        (K * σ * Real.sqrt τ)) K

name: MathFin.riskNeutralProb_S_T_gt_K
statement:
theorem riskNeutralProb_S_T_gt_K
    {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω}
    {Q : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
    {S_0 K r σ T : ℝ} {Z : Ω → ℝ}
    (h : BSCallHyp Q S_0 K r σ T Z) :
    (Q {ω | bsTerminal S_0 r σ T (Z ω) > K}).toReal =
      Phi (bsd2 S_0 K r σ T)

name: MathFin.bsV_spot_convexOn
statement:
theorem bsV_spot_convexOn {K r σ τ : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (hσ : 0 < σ) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    ConvexOn ℝ (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)) (fun s ↦ bsV K r σ s τ)

name: MathFin.bsV_spot_tangent_le
statement:
theorem bsV_spot_tangent_le {K r σ τ : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (hσ : 0 < σ)
    (hτ : 0 < τ) {S₀ s : ℝ} (hS₀ : 0 < S₀) (hs : 0 < s) :
    bsV K r σ S₀ τ + Phi (bsd1 S₀ K r σ τ) * (s - S₀) ≤ bsV K r σ s τ

name: MathFin.convexOn_call_payoff_spot
statement:
lemma convexOn_call_payoff_spot (K : ℝ) :
    ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun S : ℝ ↦ max (S - K) 0)

name: MathFin.bull_call_spread_payoff_le
statement:
lemma bull_call_spread_payoff_le (S K₁ K₂ : ℝ) (h : K₁ ≤ K₂) :
    max (S - K₂) 0 ≤ max (S - K₁) 0

name: MathFin.butterfly_payoff_nonneg
statement:
lemma butterfly_payoff_nonneg (S K₁ K₃ : ℝ) (_h : K₁ ≤ K₃) :
    0 ≤
      max (S - K₁) 0 -
        2 * max (S - (K₁ + K₃) / 2) 0 +
        max (S - K₃) 0

name: MathFin.bsCall_asset_piece_integral
statement:
theorem bsCall_asset_piece_integral
    {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω}
    {Q : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
    {S_0 K r σ T : ℝ} {Z : Ω → ℝ}
    (h : BSCallHyp Q S_0 K r σ T Z) :
    ∫ ω, (Set.Ioi (-bsd2 S_0 K r σ T)).indicator
      (bsTerminal S_0 r σ T) (Z ω) ∂Q =
        S_0 * Real.exp (r * T) * Phi (bsd1 S_0 K r σ T)

name: MathFin.stockNumeraireDensity_real_nonneg
statement:
lemma stockNumeraireDensity_real_nonneg
    {Ω : Type*}
    {S_0 r σ T : ℝ} (hS_0 : 0 < S_0) (Z : Ω → ℝ) (ω : Ω) :
    0 ≤ Real.exp (-r * T) * bsTerminal S_0 r σ T (Z ω) / S_0

name: MathFin.stockNumeraireMeasure_eq_numeraireMeasure
statement:
theorem stockNumeraireMeasure_eq_numeraireMeasure
    {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} (Q : Measure Ω)
    (S_0 r σ T : ℝ) (Z : Ω → ℝ) :
    stockNumeraireMeasure Q S_0 r σ T Z
      = numeraireMeasure Q (fun _ ↦ Real.exp (r * T))
          (fun ω ↦ bsTerminal S_0 r σ T (Z ω)) 1 S_0

name: MathFin.stockNumeraire_exercise_probability
statement:
theorem stockNumeraire_exercise_probability
    {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω}
    {Q : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
    {S_0 K r σ T : ℝ} {Z : Ω → ℝ}
    (h : BSCallHyp Q S_0 K r σ T Z) :
    (∫ ω, (Set.Ioi (-bsd2 S_0 K r σ T)).indicator
      (fun z ↦ Real.exp (-r * T) * bsTerminal S_0 r σ T z / S_0) (Z ω) ∂Q) =
        Phi (bsd1 S_0 K r σ T)

name: MathFin.hasDerivAt_bsP_K
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_bsP_K {S r σ : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S) (hσ : 0 < σ)

name: MathFin.hasDerivAt_bsV_K
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_bsV_K {S r σ : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S) (hσ : 0 < σ)
    {K τ : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun k ↦ bsV k r σ S τ)

name: MathFin.hasDerivAt_bsV_KK
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_bsV_KK {S r σ : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S) (hσ : 0 < σ)
    {K τ : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun k ↦ -(Real.exp (-(r * τ)) * Phi (bsd2 S k r σ τ)))
      (Real.exp (-(r * τ)) * gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (bsd2 S K r σ τ) /
        (K * σ * Real.sqrt τ)) K

name: MathFin.hasDerivAt_bsd1_K
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_bsd1_K (S r σ τ : ℝ) (hS : 0 < S) (hσ : 0 < σ) (hτ : 0 < τ)
    {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) :
    HasDerivAt (fun k ↦ bsd1 S k r σ τ) (-(1 / (K * σ * Real.sqrt τ))) K

name: MathFin.hasDerivAt_bsd2_K
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_bsd2_K (S r σ τ : ℝ) (hS : 0 < S) (hσ : 0 < σ) (hτ : 0 < τ)

    HasDerivAt (fun k ↦ bsd2 S k r σ τ) (-(1 / (K * σ * Real.sqrt τ))) K

name: MathFin.integral_bsTerminal_eq_forward
statement:
lemma integral_bsTerminal_eq_forward (S_0 r σ T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) :
    ∫ z, S_0 * Real.exp ((r - σ ^ 2 / 2) * T + σ * Real.sqrt T * z) ∂(gaussianReal 0 1)
      = S_0 * Real.exp (r * T)

name: MathFin.integral_excess_return_eq_zero
statement:
lemma integral_excess_return_eq_zero (S_0 r σ T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) :
    ∫ z, (S_0 * Real.exp ((r - σ ^ 2 / 2) * T + σ * Real.sqrt T * z)
            - S_0 * Real.exp (r * T)) / (S_0 * Real.exp (r * T)) ∂(gaussianReal 0 1) = 0

name: MathFin.integral_log_forward_div_bsTerminal_eq
statement:
lemma integral_log_forward_div_bsTerminal_eq {S_0 : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S_0)
    (r σ T : ℝ) :
    ∫ z, Real.log ((S_0 * Real.exp (r * T)) /
                  (S_0 * Real.exp ((r - σ^2/2) * T + σ * Real.sqrt T * z)))
      ∂(gaussianReal 0 1) = σ^2 * T / 2

name: MathFin.log_forward_div_bsTerminal_eq
statement:
lemma log_forward_div_bsTerminal_eq {S_0 : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S_0) (r σ T z : ℝ) :
    Real.log ((S_0 * Real.exp (r * T)) /
              (S_0 * Real.exp ((r - σ^2/2) * T + σ * Real.sqrt T * z)))
      = σ^2 * T / 2 - σ * Real.sqrt T * z

name: MathFin.varianceSwap_fairStrike
statement:
theorem varianceSwap_fairStrike {S_0 : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S_0) (r σ T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T) :
    (2 / T) *
        ((∫ z, Real.log ((S_0 * Real.exp (r * T)) /
              (S_0 * Real.exp ((r - σ ^ 2 / 2) * T + σ * Real.sqrt T * z)))
            ∂(gaussianReal 0 1))
         + ∫ z, (S_0 * Real.exp ((r - σ ^ 2 / 2) * T + σ * Real.sqrt T * z)
              - S_0 * Real.exp (r * T)) / (S_0 * Real.exp (r * T)) ∂(gaussianReal 0 1))
      = σ ^ 2

name: MathFin.varianceSwap_log_contribution
statement:
theorem varianceSwap_log_contribution {S_0 : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S_0)
    (r σ T : ℝ) (hT : T ≠ 0) :
    (2 / T) *
      (∫ z, Real.log ((S_0 * Real.exp (r * T)) /
            (S_0 * Real.exp ((r - σ^2/2) * T + σ * Real.sqrt T * z)))
        ∂(gaussianReal 0 1)) = σ^2

name: MathFin.portfolioVarN_diag_eq_herfindahl
statement:
theorem portfolioVarN_diag_eq_herfindahl {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι)
    (w : ι → ℝ) (σ : ι → ι → ℝ) (σ_sq : ℝ)
    (h_diag : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ s, i ≠ j → σ i j = 0)
    (h_var : ∀ i ∈ s, σ i i = σ_sq) :
    portfolioVarN s w σ = σ_sq * herfindahl s w

name: MathFin.gompertz_cumHazard
statement:
theorem gompertz_cumHazard (B c t : ℝ) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    cumHazard (fun u ↦ B * Real.exp (c * u)) t = (B / c) * (Real.exp (c * t) - 1)

name: MathFin.survivalFromForce_eq_hazardSurvival
statement:
theorem survivalFromForce_eq_hazardSurvival (μ : ℝ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    survivalFromForce μ t = hazardSurvival μ t

name: MathFin.Contracts.Payoff.aemeasurable_eval

name: MathFin.Contracts.Payoff.measurable_eval

name: MathFin.Contracts.Payoff.measurable_eval_of_obsTimes_le
statement:
theorem Payoff.measurable_eval_of_obsTimes_le
    {𝓕 : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ} {u : ℝ≥0} (e : Payoff ι) (X : ι → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ)
    (hX : ∀ i t, Measurable[𝓕 t] (X i t))
    (hle : ∀ t ∈ e.obsTimes, t ≤ u) :
    Measurable[𝓕 u] fun ω ↦ e.eval (fun i t ↦ X i t ω)

name: MathFin.Contracts.value_europeanCall
statement:
theorem value_europeanCall {Q : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
    {S_0 K r σ : ℝ} {T : ℝ≥0} {Z : Ω → ℝ} (h : BSCallHyp Q S_0 K r σ T Z) :
    (europeanCall K T).value Q (fun _ ↦ Real.exp (-r * T)) (bsAssets S_0 r σ T Z)
      = S_0 * Phi (bsd1 S_0 K r σ T) - K * Real.exp (-r * T) * Phi (bsd2 S_0 K r σ T)

name: MathFin.Contracts.value_europeanPut
statement:
theorem value_europeanPut {Q : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
    {S_0 K r σ : ℝ} {T : ℝ≥0} {Z : Ω → ℝ} (h : BSCallHyp Q S_0 K r σ T Z) :
    (europeanPut K T).value Q (fun _ ↦ Real.exp (-r * T)) (bsAssets S_0 r σ T Z)
      = K * Real.exp (-r * T) * Phi (-(bsd2 S_0 K r σ T)) - S_0 * Phi (-(bsd1 S_0 K r σ T))

name: MathFin.Contracts.Contract.pathPV_both
statement:
theorem Contract.pathPV_both (D : ℝ≥0 → ℝ) (s : Scenario ι)
    (a b : Contract ι) :
    (Contract.both a b).pathPV D s = a.pathPV D s + b.pathPV D s

name: MathFin.Contracts.Contract.pathPV_scale
statement:
theorem Contract.pathPV_scale (D : ℝ≥0 → ℝ) (s : Scenario ι)
    (c : ℝ) (a : Contract ι) :
    (Contract.scale c a).pathPV D s = c * a.pathPV D s

name: MathFin.Contracts.Contract.value_both
statement:
theorem Contract.value_both (Q : Measure Ω) (D : ℝ≥0 → ℝ)
    (X : ι → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (a b : Contract ι)
    (ha : Integrable (fun ω ↦ a.pathPV D (scenarioAt X ω)) Q)
    (hb : Integrable (fun ω ↦ b.pathPV D (scenarioAt X ω)) Q) :
    (Contract.both a b).value Q D X = a.value Q D X + b.value Q D X

name: MathFin.Contracts.Contract.value_deliverAsset
statement:
theorem Contract.value_deliverAsset {𝓕 : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ}
    {S : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ} {Q : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
    (hM : Martingale S 𝓕 Q) (T : ℝ≥0) :
    (Contract.pay T (Payoff.obs () T)).value Q (fun _ ↦ 1) (fun _ ↦ S)
      = ∫ ω, S 0 ω ∂Q

name: MathFin.Contracts.Contract.value_process_martingale
statement:
theorem Contract.value_process_martingale {Q : Measure Ω} {𝓕 : Filtration ℝ≥0 mΩ}
    [SigmaFiniteFiltration Q 𝓕] (D : ℝ≥0 → ℝ) (X : ι → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ)
    (c : Contract ι) :
    Martingale (fun t ↦ Q[fun ω ↦ c.pathPV D (scenarioAt X ω) | 𝓕 t]) 𝓕 Q

name: MathFin.Contracts.Contract.value_scale
statement:
theorem Contract.value_scale (Q : Measure Ω) (D : ℝ≥0 → ℝ)
    (X : ι → ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (r : ℝ) (a : Contract ι) :
    (Contract.scale r a).value Q D X = r * a.value Q D X

name: MathFin.DeFi.marginal_exchange_rate

name: MathFin.DeFi.swap_preserves_invariant

name: MathFin.Execution.buy_denom_pos

theorem buy_denom_pos {θ p : ℝ} (hθ0 : 0 < θ) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) :

name: MathFin.Execution.cond_buy_high_toReal
statement:
theorem cond_buy_high_toReal (H B : Set Ω) {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p)
    (hhigh : 2 * μ[B | H] = 1 + ENNReal.ofReal p) :

name: MathFin.Execution.cond_buy_low_toReal

name: MathFin.Execution.cond_compl_toReal

theorem cond_compl_toReal [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (E F : Set Ω) (hE : MeasurableSet E)
    (hF0 : μ F ≠ 0) :
    (μ[Eᶜ | F]).toReal = 1 - (μ[E | F]).toReal

name: MathFin.Execution.cond_toReal_eq
statement:
theorem cond_toReal_eq [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (E H : Set Ω) (hE : MeasurableSet E) (hH : MeasurableSet H)
    {a c t : ℝ} (ha : (μ[E | H]).toReal = a) (hc : (μ[E | Hᶜ]).toReal = c)
    (ht : (μ H).toReal = t) :
    (μ[H | E]).toReal = a * t / (a * t + c * (1 - t))

name: MathFin.Execution.integral_payoff
statement:
theorem integral_payoff (ν : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (H : Set Ω)
    (hH : MeasurableSet H) (VL VH : ℝ) :
    ∫ ω, payoff H VL VH ω ∂ν = VL + (ν H).toReal * (VH - VL)

name: MathFin.Execution.integral_payoff_cond

    (hE0 : μ E ≠ 0) (VL VH : ℝ) :

name: MathFin.Execution.inter_informed

name: MathFin.Execution.measure_toReal_of_likelihoods
statement:
theorem measure_toReal_of_likelihoods [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (E H : Set Ω) (hH : MeasurableSet H)

name: MathFin.Execution.postBuy_eq

name: MathFin.Execution.postSell_lt_postBuy

theorem postSell_lt_postBuy {θ p : ℝ} (hθ0 : 0 < θ) (hθ1 : θ < 1) (hp0 : 0 < p)

name: MathFin.Execution.postSell_one_one
statement: theorem postSell_one_one : postSell 1 1 = 0

name: MathFin.Execution.post_sub_post
statement:
theorem post_sub_post {θ p : ℝ} (hθ0 : 0 < θ) (hθ1 : θ < 1) (hp0 : 0 < p)
    (hp1 : p ≤ 1) :
    postBuy θ p - postSell θ p
      = 4 * p * θ * (1 - θ) / (1 - p ^ 2 * (2 * θ - 1) ^ 2)

name: MathFin.Execution.quote_eq_zero_of_null

theorem quote_eq_zero_of_null (H B : Set Ω) (VL VH : ℝ) (hB : μ B = 0) :

name: MathFin.Execution.sell_denom_pos

theorem sell_denom_pos {θ p : ℝ} (hθ1 : θ < 1) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) :

name: MathFin.Execution.spread_eq
statement:
theorem spread_eq [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (B S H : Set Ω) (hH : MeasurableSet H)
    (hB0 : μ B ≠ 0) (hS0 : μ S ≠ 0) (VL VH : ℝ) :
    (∫ ω, payoff H VL VH ω ∂(μ[|B])) - (∫ ω, payoff H VL VH ω ∂(μ[|S]))
      = (VH - VL) * ((μ[H | B]).toReal - (μ[H | S]).toReal)

name: MathFin.Execution.spread_junk_at_corner
statement:
theorem spread_junk_at_corner (VL VH : ℝ) :
    (VH - VL) * (postBuy 1 1 - postSell 1 1) = VH - VL

name: MathFin.Execution.spread_pos
statement:
theorem spread_pos {θ p VL VH : ℝ} (hθ0 : 0 < θ) (hθ1 : θ < 1) (hp0 : 0 < p)
    (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (hV : VL < VH) :
    0 < (VH - VL) * (postBuy θ p - postSell θ p)

name: MathFin.Execution.spread_pos_of_model
statement:
theorem spread_pos_of_model [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (H B I : Set Ω)
    (hH : MeasurableSet H) (hB : MeasurableSet B) (hI : MeasurableSet I)
    {θ p VL VH : ℝ}
    (hθ0 : 0 < θ) (hθ1 : θ < 1) (hp0 : 0 < p) (hV : VL < VH)
    (hprior : μ H = ENNReal.ofReal θ)
    (hbuy : B ∩ I = H ∩ I)
    (hindepH : μ (H ∩ I) = ENNReal.ofReal p * ENNReal.ofReal θ)
    (hindepHc : μ (Hᶜ ∩ I) = ENNReal.ofReal p * ENNReal.ofReal (1 - θ))
    (huninfH : 2 * μ ((H ∩ B) \ I) = μ (H \ I))
    (huninfHc : 2 * μ ((Hᶜ ∩ B) \ I) = μ (Hᶜ \ I)) :
    0 < (∫ ω, payoff H VL VH ω ∂(μ[|B])) - (∫ ω, payoff H VL VH ω ∂(μ[|Bᶜ]))

name: MathFin.Execution.two_mul_cond_buy_high
statement:
theorem two_mul_cond_buy_high (H B I : Set Ω) (hH' : MeasurableSet H) (hI : MeasurableSet I)
    {θ p : ℝ≥0∞} (hθ0 : θ ≠ 0) (hθtop : θ ≠ ∞)
    (hbuy : B ∩ I = H ∩ I) (hindep : μ (H ∩ I) = p * θ) (hH : μ H = θ)
    (huninf : 2 * μ ((H ∩ B) \ I) = μ (H \ I)) :
    2 * μ[B | H] = 1 + p

name: MathFin.Execution.two_mul_cond_buy_low_add
statement:
theorem two_mul_cond_buy_low_add (H B I : Set Ω) (hHc : MeasurableSet Hᶜ)
    (hI : MeasurableSet I) {θ' p : ℝ≥0∞} (hθ0 : θ' ≠ 0) (hθtop : θ' ≠ ∞)
    (hbuy : B ∩ I = H ∩ I)
    (hindep : μ (Hᶜ ∩ I) = p * θ')
    (hHc' : μ Hᶜ = θ')
    (huninf : 2 * μ ((Hᶜ ∩ B) \ I) = μ (Hᶜ \ I)) :
    2 * μ[B | Hᶜ] + p = 1

name: MathFin.Execution.two_mul_inter_high_buy
statement:
theorem two_mul_inter_high_buy (H B I : Set Ω) (hI : MeasurableSet I) {θ p : ℝ≥0∞}
    (hbuy : B ∩ I = H ∩ I)
    (hindep : μ (H ∩ I) = p * θ)
    (hH : μ H = θ)
    (huninf : 2 * μ ((H ∩ B) \ I) = μ (H \ I)) :
    2 * μ (H ∩ B) = (1 + p) * θ

name: MathFin.cdsFairSpread_TV_cash_flow_balance

theorem cdsFairSpread_TV_cash_flow_balance
    (c R annuity losses : ℝ) (h_annuity_ne : annuity ≠ 0) :
    c * annuity = (1 - R) * losses ↔ c = (1 - R) * losses / annuity

name: MathFin.survival_product_eq_exp_sum
statement:
theorem survival_product_eq_exp_sum (n : ℕ) (h Δt : Fin n → ℝ) :

name: MathFin.bondPortfolio_immunization_second_order
statement:
lemma bondPortfolio_immunization_second_order
    {ι κ : Type*}
    (sA : Finset ι) (wA TA : ι → ℝ)
    (sL : Finset κ) (wL TL : κ → ℝ)
    (t r : ℝ)
    (h_match_conv :
      bondPortfolioConv sA wA TA t r = bondPortfolioConv sL wL TL t r) :
    HasDerivAt (fun r' ↦
        -bondPortfolioDur sA wA TA t r' -
        (-bondPortfolioDur sL wL TL t r'))
      0 r

name: MathFin.bondPriceDisc_secondDeriv_eq_convexity_times_price
statement:
theorem bondPriceDisc_secondDeriv_eq_convexity_times_price
    (s : Finset ι) (t : ι → ℕ) (c : ι → ℝ) {y : ℝ}
    (hy : 1 + y ≠ 0) :
    ∃ P'' : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun y' ↦ -modifiedNumerator s t c y') P'' y ∧
      P'' / bondPriceDisc s t c y =
        convexityNumerator s t c y / bondPriceDisc s t c y

theorem hasDerivAt_bondPriceDisc_secondDeriv
    (s : Finset ι) (t : ι → ℕ) (c : ι → ℝ) {y : ℝ} (hy : 1 + y ≠ 0) :

               (convexityNumerator s t c y) y

theorem hasDerivAt_modifiedNumerator

name: MathFin.annuityValue_closed_form
statement:
lemma annuityValue_closed_form (n : ℕ) (c r Δt : ℝ)

name: MathFin.bondPriceDisc_deriv_eq_neg_modified_duration_times_price

name: MathFin.fraValue_forwardRate_eq_discount_difference

theorem fraValue_forwardRate_eq_discount_difference (P1 P2 δ K : ℝ)
    (hδ : δ ≠ 0) (hP2 : P2 ≠ 0) :
    fraValue δ P2 (fraForwardRate P1 P2 δ) K = P1 - P2 - δ * P2 * K

theorem fraValue_zcb_eq_discount_difference (r δ K T1 T2 : ℝ) (hδ : δ ≠ 0) :
    fraValue δ (zcb r 0 T2) (fraForwardRate (zcb r 0 T1) (zcb r 0 T2) δ) K =
      zcb r 0 T1 - zcb r 0 T2 - δ * zcb r 0 T2 * K

name: MathFin.fraValue_zcb_eq_zero_iff

name: MathFin.kmvPD_eq_one_sub_survival_probability
statement:
theorem kmvPD_eq_one_sub_survival_probability
    {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω}
    {Q : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
    {V_0 F r σ_V T : ℝ} {Z : Ω → ℝ}
    (hV : 0 < V_0) (hF : 0 < F)
    (h : BSCallHyp Q V_0 F r σ_V T Z) :
    kmvPD V_0 F r σ_V T =
      1 - (Q {ω | bsTerminal V_0 r σ_V T (Z ω) > F}).toReal

name: MathFin.merton_equity_eq_bs_call
statement:
theorem merton_equity_eq_bs_call
    {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω}
    {Q : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
    {V_0 F r σ_V T : ℝ} {Z : Ω → ℝ}
    (h : BSCallHyp Q V_0 F r σ_V T Z) :
    ∫ ω, Real.exp (-r * T) *
        max (bsTerminal V_0 r σ_V T (Z ω) - F) 0 ∂Q =
      V_0 * Phi (bsd1 V_0 F r σ_V T) -
        F * Real.exp (-r * T) * Phi (bsd2 V_0 F r σ_V T)

name: MathFin.survival_probability_eq_Phi_distanceToDefault
statement:
theorem survival_probability_eq_Phi_distanceToDefault
    {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω}
    {Q : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
    {V_0 F r σ_V T : ℝ} {Z : Ω → ℝ}
    (hV : 0 < V_0) (hF : 0 < F)
    (h : BSCallHyp Q V_0 F r σ_V T Z) :
    (Q {ω | bsTerminal V_0 r σ_V T (Z ω) > F}).toReal =
      Phi (kmvDistanceToDefault V_0 F r σ_V T)

name: MathFin.bootstrap_consistency
statement:
lemma bootstrap_consistency {ι : Type*} (sprev : Finset ι) (c B : ι → ℝ)
    (P c_last F : ℝ) (h : c_last + F ≠ 0) :
    couponBondPricingEq sprev c B P c_last F
      ((P - ∑ i ∈ sprev, c i * B i) / (c_last + F))

name: MathFin.bootstrap_solve

lemma bootstrap_solve {ι : Type*} (sprev : Finset ι) (c B : ι → ℝ)

    (hP : couponBondPricingEq sprev c B P c_last F B_last) :
    B_last = (P - ∑ i ∈ sprev, c i * B i) / (c_last + F)

lemma bootstrap_solve_first (P c_last F B_last : ℝ) (h : c_last + F ≠ 0)

name: MathFin.carrMadan_log_spanning
statement:
theorem carrMadan_log_spanning {L U κ S : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L)
    (hLκ : L ≤ κ) (hκU : κ ≤ U) (hS : S ∈ Set.Icc L U) :
    Real.log S = Real.log κ + κ⁻¹ * (S - κ)
      + (∫ K in L..κ, -(K ^ 2)⁻¹ * max (K - S) 0)
      + (∫ K in κ..U, -(K ^ 2)⁻¹ * max (S - K) 0)

name: MathFin.carrMadan_spanning
statement:
theorem carrMadan_spanning {f f' f'' : ℝ → ℝ} {L U κ S : ℝ}
    (hLκ : L ≤ κ) (hκU : κ ≤ U) (hS : S ∈ Set.Icc L U)
    (hf : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc L U, HasDerivAt f (f' t) t)
    (hf' : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc L U, HasDerivAt f' (f'' t) t)
    (hf'' : ContinuousOn f'' (Set.Icc L U)) :
    f S = f κ + f' κ * (S - κ)
      + (∫ K in L..κ, f'' K * max (K - S) 0)
      + (∫ K in κ..U, f'' K * max (S - K) 0)

name: MathFin.discrete_ito_formula
statement:
theorem discrete_ito_formula
    (N : ℕ) (X : ℕ → ℝ) (f f' f'' : ℝ → ℝ) :
    f (X N) - f (X 0) =
      (∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, f' (X k) * (X (k + 1) - X k)) +
      (1 / 2) *
        (∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, f'' (X k) * (X (k + 1) - X k) ^ 2) +
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N,
        discreteTaylorRemainder f f' f'' (X k) (X (k + 1))

      3 * (∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, X k * (X (k + 1) - X k) ^ 2) +

name: MathFin.doob_decomposition
statement:
theorem doob_decomposition [SigmaFiniteFiltration μ ℱ]
    {f : ℕ → Ω → E} (hf : StronglyAdapted ℱ f) (hf_int : ∀ n, Integrable (f n) μ) :
    ∃ M A : ℕ → Ω → E,
      (Martingale M ℱ μ ∧ (StronglyAdapted ℱ fun n ↦ A (n + 1)) ∧ A 0 = 0 ∧
        M + A = f) ∧
      ∀ M' A' : ℕ → Ω → E, Martingale M' ℱ μ →
        (StronglyAdapted ℱ fun n ↦ A' (n + 1)) → A' 0 = 0 →
        (∀ n, Integrable (A' n) μ) → M' + A' = f →
        ∀ n, M' n =ᵐ[μ] M n ∧ A' n =ᵐ[μ] A n

    (hA_int : ∀ n, Integrable (A n) μ)
    (hMA : M + A = f) (n : ℕ) :

theorem expectation_ito
    {B : ℝ → Ω → ℝ}
    (hB_meas : ∀ t, Measurable (B t))
    (hB_zero : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, B 0 ω = 0)
    (hB_gauss : ∀ ⦃s t : ℝ⦄, s ≤ t →
      ∃ v : NNReal, (v : ℝ) = t - s ∧
        Measure.map (fun ω ↦ B t ω - B s ω) μ = gaussianReal 0 v)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) {f f' f'' : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ x, HasDerivAt f (f' x) x) (hf' : ∀ x, HasDerivAt f' (f'' x) x)
    (hf''c : Continuous f'') {Cf Cf' Cf'' : ℝ}
    (hCf : ∀ x, |f x| ≤ Cf) (hCf' : ∀ x, |f' x| ≤ Cf') (hCf'' : ∀ x, |f'' x| ≤ Cf'') :
    (∫ ω, f (B t ω) ∂μ) = f 0 + ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..t, (1 / 2) * ∫ ω, f'' (B s ω) ∂μ

    (∫ ω, f (X t.toNNReal ω) ∂μ)
      = f 0 + ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..t, (1 / 2) * ∫ ω, f'' (X s.toNNReal ω) ∂μ

    (∫ z, h z * (heatKernel t (z - x) * ((z - x) ^ 2 - t) / (2 * t ^ 2)) ∂volume)

name: MathFin.FeynmanKacHeatEquation.hasDerivAt_feynmanU_comp
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_feynmanU_comp {h : ℝ → ℝ} (hhc : Continuous h) (hh : ∀ z, |h z| ≤ Real.exp z)
    {α β x₀ τ : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s ↦ feynmanU h (α * s) (x₀ + β * s))
      (∫ z, h z * (α * (heatKernel (α * τ) (z - (x₀ + β * τ))
              * ((z - (x₀ + β * τ)) ^ 2 - α * τ) / (2 * (α * τ) ^ 2))
          + β * ((z - (x₀ + β * τ)) / (α * τ)
              * heatKernel (α * τ) (z - (x₀ + β * τ)))) ∂volume) τ

    (hv : HasDerivAt v vd τ₀) (hw : HasDerivAt w wd τ₀) (hvpos : 0 < v τ₀) (z : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s ↦ heatKernel (v s) (z - w s))
      (vd * (heatKernel (v τ₀) (z - w τ₀) * ((z - w τ₀) ^ 2 - v τ₀) / (2 * (v τ₀) ^ 2))
        + wd * ((z - w τ₀) / (v τ₀) * heatKernel (v τ₀) (z - w τ₀))) τ₀

name: MathFin.bs_call_formula_of_physical
statement:
theorem bs_call_formula_of_physical {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω}
    {P : Measure Ω}
    {S_0 K r σ T : ℝ} {W : Ω → ℝ} (c : ℝ)
    (hS_0 : 0 < S_0) (hK : 0 < K) (hσ : 0 < σ) (hT : 0 < T)
    (hWmeas : Measurable W) (hW : HasLaw W (gaussianReal 0 1) P) :
    ∃ (Q : Measure Ω) (_ : IsProbabilityMeasure Q),
      Q = P.withDensity (fun ω ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (c * W ω - c ^ 2 / 2))) ∧
      ∫ ω, Real.exp (-r * T) * max (bsTerminal S_0 r σ T (W ω - c) - K) 0 ∂Q
        = S_0 * Phi (bsd1 S_0 K r σ T)
          - K * Real.exp (-r * T) * Phi (bsd2 S_0 K r σ T)

theorem discrete_ito_formula_2d
    (N : ℕ) (t X : ℕ → ℝ) (f f_t f_x f_xx : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) :
    f (t N) (X N) - f (t 0) (X 0) =
      (∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, f_t (t k) (X k) * (t (k + 1) - t k)) +
      (∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, f_x (t k) (X k) * (X (k + 1) - X k)) +
      (1 / 2) *
        (∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, f_xx (t k) (X k) * (X (k + 1) - X k) ^ 2) +
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N,
        discreteTaylorRemainder2D f f_t f_x f_xx (t k) (t (k + 1)) (X k) (X (k + 1))

statement:
theorem valueFunction_satisfies_approxHJ
    (γ σ z α₀b α₁b α₂b α₀a α₁a α₂a : ℝ) (hz : 0 < z)
    (A B C : ℝ → ℝ) (t q : ℝ)
    (hA : HasDerivAt A (2 * z * (α₂b + α₂a) * A t ^ 2 - γ * σ ^ 2 / 2) t)
    (hB : HasDerivAt B (2 * z * (α₁b - α₁a) * A t + 2 * z ^ 2 * (α₂b - α₂a) * A t ^ 2
                        + 2 * z * (α₂b + α₂a) * A t * B t) t)
    (hC : HasDerivAt C (z * (α₀b + α₀a) + z ^ 2 * (α₁b + α₁a) * A t + z * (α₁b - α₁a) * B t
                        + z ^ 3 * (α₂b + α₂a) * A t ^ 2 / 2 + z * (α₂b + α₂a) * B t ^ 2 / 2
                        + z ^ 2 * (α₂b - α₂a) * A t * B t) t) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => -(A s) * q ^ 2 - B s * q - C s)
      (γ * σ ^ 2 / 2 * q ^ 2 - z * (α₀b + α₀a)
        - α₁b * (2 * A t * q * z + A t * z ^ 2 + B t * z)
        - α₁a * (-2 * A t * q * z + A t * z ^ 2 - B t * z)
        - (1 / (2 * z)) * (α₂b * (2 * A t * q * z + A t * z ^ 2 + B t * z) ^ 2
                    + α₂a * (-2 * A t * q * z + A t * z ^ 2 - B t * z) ^ 2)) t

      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, ξ i ω) ≤ t ∧ t < ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), ξ i ω)

theorem map_firstArrival_eq_expMeasure [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {rate : ℝ≥0} (hrate : 0 < rate) {N : ℝ → Ω → ℕ}
    (hmeas : ∀ t, Measurable (N t)) (hzero : ∀ ω, N 0 ω = 0)
    (hincr : ∀ ⦃s t : ℝ⦄, 0 ≤ s → (hst : s ≤ t) →
      Measure.map (fun ω ↦ N t ω - N s ω) μ
        = poissonMeasure (rate * ⟨t - s, sub_nonneg.mpr hst⟩))
    {τ : Ω → ℝ} (hτ_meas : Measurable τ) (hτ_nonneg : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ τ ω)
    (hτ_first : ∀ ⦃t : ℝ⦄, 0 ≤ t → {ω | t < τ ω} = {ω | N t ω = 0}) :

name: MathFin.bachelier_call_formula_via_brownian
statement:
theorem bachelier_call_formula_via_brownian
    {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω}
    (Q : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
    (W : ℝ≥0 → Ω → ℝ) (hW : IsPreBrownianReal W Q)
    {S_0 K σ T : ℝ}
    (hK : 0 < K) (hσ : 0 < σ) (hT : 0 < T) :
    ∫ ω, max (bachelierTerminal S_0 σ T
        (W T.toNNReal ω / Real.sqrt T) - K) 0 ∂Q
      = (S_0 - K) * Phi (bachelierD S_0 K σ T) +
        σ * Real.sqrt T *
          gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (bachelierD S_0 K σ T)

    ∫ ω, Real.exp (-r * T) *
        (Set.Ioi K).indicator (fun s ↦ s)
          (bsTerminal S_0 r σ T (W T.toNNReal ω / Real.sqrt T)) ∂Q
      = S_0 * Phi (bsd1 S_0 K r σ T)

        max (bsTerminal S_0 r σ T (W T.toNNReal ω / Real.sqrt T) - K) 0 ∂Q

statement:
theorem bs_power_call_formula_via_brownian
    {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω}

          (W T.toNNReal ω / Real.sqrt T) - K) 0 ∂Q =
      bsPowerEffectiveSpot S_0 r σ T a *

statement:
theorem sde_pathwise_uniqueness
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    {μ_coef : ℝ → ℝ} {X Y : ℝ → Ω → ℝ} {Iσ : (ℝ → Ω → ℝ) → ℝ → Ω → ℝ}
    {Cdrift Cdiff : ℝ} (hCd : 0 ≤ Cdrift)
    (hXYint : ∀ s, 0 ≤ s → Integrable (fun ω ↦ (X s ω - Y s ω) ^ 2) μ)
    (hDint : ∀ s, 0 ≤ s →
      Integrable (fun ω ↦ (∫ u in (0:ℝ)..s, μ_coef (X u ω) - μ_coef (Y u ω)) ^ 2) μ)
    (hJint : ∀ s, 0 ≤ s → Integrable (fun ω ↦ ((Iσ X) s ω - (Iσ Y) s ω) ^ 2) μ)
    (hEcont : ContinuousOn (fun s ↦ ∫ ω, (X s ω - Y s ω) ^ 2 ∂μ) (Set.Ici 0))
    (hdecomp : ∀ s, 0 ≤ s → ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, X s ω - Y s ω
      = (∫ u in (0:ℝ)..s, μ_coef (X u ω) - μ_coef (Y u ω)) + ((Iσ X) s ω - (Iσ Y) s ω))
    (hdrift : ∀ s, 0 ≤ s →
      (∫ ω, (∫ u in (0:ℝ)..s, μ_coef (X u ω) - μ_coef (Y u ω)) ^ 2 ∂μ)
        ≤ Cdrift * s * ∫ u in (0:ℝ)..s, (∫ ω, (X u ω - Y u ω) ^ 2 ∂μ))
    (hIso : ∀ s, 0 ≤ s →
      (∫ ω, ((Iσ X) s ω - (Iσ Y) s ω) ^ 2 ∂μ)
        ≤ Cdiff * ∫ u in (0:ℝ)..s, (∫ ω, (X u ω - Y u ω) ^ 2 ∂μ)) :
    ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, X t ω = Y t ω

theorem expected_bsLogPrice_equipartition_sum
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hB : BrownianQuadraticVariation μ B) (S_0 r σ : ℝ)

name: MathFin.varianceSwap_log_eq_QV_limit_value
statement:
theorem varianceSwap_log_eq_QV_limit_value
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {B : ℝ → Ω → ℝ} (hB : BrownianQuadraticVariation μ B)
    {S_0 : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S_0) (r σ : ℝ) {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) :
    -- Log-payoff (static-replication) form = σ²
    (2 / T) * (∫ z, Real.log ((S_0 * Real.exp (r * T)) /
        (S_0 * Real.exp ((r - σ^2/2) * T + σ * Real.sqrt T * z))) ∂(gaussianReal 0 1))
      = σ ^ 2 ∧
    -- Realised-variance QV-limit form → σ²·T (the genuine equipartition functional)
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun n : ℕ ↦ ∫ ω, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        (bsLogPrice S_0 r σ B (((k : ℝ) + 1) * T / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) ω -
         bsLogPrice S_0 r σ B ((k : ℝ) * T / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) ω) ^ 2 ∂μ)
      Filter.atTop (nhds (σ ^ 2 * T))

    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hB : BrownianQuadraticVariation μ B)
    (S_0 r σ : ℝ) {s t : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hst : s ≤ t) :
    ∫ ω, (bsLogPrice S_0 r σ B t ω - bsLogPrice S_0 r σ B s ω) ^ 2 ∂μ
      = σ ^ 2 * (t - s) + (r - σ ^ 2 / 2) ^ 2 * (t - s) ^ 2

name: MathFin.tendsto_expected_bsLogPrice_equipartition_sum
statement:
theorem tendsto_expected_bsLogPrice_equipartition_sum
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hB : BrownianQuadraticVariation μ B) (S_0 r σ : ℝ)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 ≤ T) :
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun n : ℕ ↦ ∫ ω, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        (bsLogPrice S_0 r σ B (((k : ℝ) + 1) * T / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) ω -
         bsLogPrice S_0 r σ B ((k : ℝ) * T / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) ω) ^ 2 ∂μ)
      Filter.atTop (nhds (σ ^ 2 * T))

name: MathFin.downsideMetrics_bundle
statement:
theorem downsideMetrics_bundle {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (m : FiniteReturnModel ι) (threshold : ℝ)
    (hdown : omegaDownside m threshold ≠ 0)
    {n : ℕ} (price : Fin n → ℝ) (annualReturn c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    (0 ≤ omegaRatio m threshold ∧
      omegaRatio m threshold - 1 =
        (finiteExpectedReturn m - threshold) / omegaDownside m threshold) ∧
    (0 ≤ maximumDrawdown price ∧
      maximumDrawdown (fun i => c * price i) = c * maximumDrawdown price) ∧
    calmarRatio (c * annualReturn) (c * maximumDrawdown price) =
      calmarRatio annualReturn (maximumDrawdown price)
