      σ * (gaussianPDFReal 0 1 z / (1 - α) - z)

name: MathFin.gaussianVaR_affine
statement:
lemma gaussianVaR_affine (μ σ z a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    gaussianVaR (a * μ + b) (|a| * σ) z = a * gaussianVaR μ σ z + b

name: MathFin.gaussianVaR_standard
statement: lemma gaussianVaR_standard (z : ℝ) : gaussianVaR 0 1 z = z

name: MathFin.gaussianVaR_volatility_scaling
statement:
lemma gaussianVaR_volatility_scaling (μ σ z T : ℝ) :
    gaussianVaR (T * μ) (σ * Real.sqrt T) z = T * μ + σ * Real.sqrt T * z

name: MathFin.gaussianCVaR_eq_VaR_plus_tail_term
statement:
lemma gaussianCVaR_eq_VaR_plus_tail_term (μ σ z α : ℝ) :
    gaussianCVaR μ σ z α =
      gaussianVaR μ σ z +
        σ * (gaussianPDFReal 0 1 z / (1 - α) - z)

name: MathFin.gaussianCVaR_isLeast_ruObjective
statement:
theorem gaussianCVaR_isLeast_ruObjective (μ σ z α : ℝ) (hσ : 0 < σ)
    (hzα : Phi z = α) (hα1 : α < 1) :
    IsLeast (Set.range (ruObjective μ σ α)) (gaussianCVaR μ σ z α)

name: MathFin.gaussianCVaR_le_ruObjective
statement:
theorem gaussianCVaR_le_ruObjective (μ σ z α c : ℝ)
    (hzα : Phi z = α) (hα1 : α < 1) :
    gaussianCVaR μ σ z α ≤ ruObjective μ σ α c

name: MathFin.integrable_shortfall
statement:
lemma integrable_shortfall (μ σ c : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun x ↦ max (μ + σ * x - c) 0 * gaussianPDFReal 0 1 x) volume

name: MathFin.integral_gaussianPDFReal_Ioi
statement:
lemma integral_gaussianPDFReal_Ioi (a : ℝ) :
    ∫ x in Set.Ioi a, gaussianPDFReal 0 1 x = 1 - Phi a

name: MathFin.integral_max_sub_mul_gaussianPDFReal
statement:
lemma integral_max_sub_mul_gaussianPDFReal (z : ℝ) :
    ∫ x, max (x - z) 0 * gaussianPDFReal 0 1 x
      = gaussianPDFReal 0 1 z - z * (1 - Phi z)

name: MathFin.integral_shortfall_gaussian
statement:
lemma integral_shortfall_gaussian (μ σ c : ℝ) (hσ : 0 < σ) :
    ∫ x, max (μ + σ * x - c) 0 * gaussianPDFReal 0 1 x
      = σ * (gaussianPDFReal 0 1 ((c - μ) / σ)
          - (c - μ) / σ * (1 - Phi ((c - μ) / σ)))

name: MathFin.ruObjective_at_gaussianVaR
statement:
theorem ruObjective_at_gaussianVaR (μ σ z α : ℝ) (hσ : 0 < σ)
    (hzα : Phi z = α) (hα1 : α < 1) :
    ruObjective μ σ α (gaussianVaR μ σ z) = gaussianCVaR μ σ z α

name: MathFin.spectralRisk_convex_combination
statement:
theorem spectralRisk_convex_combination
    (s : Finset ι) (φ ψ : ι → ℝ) (Q : ι → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    t * spectralRiskFinite s φ Q + (1 - t) * spectralRiskFinite s ψ Q =
      spectralRiskFinite s (fun i ↦ t * φ i + (1 - t) * ψ i) Q

name: MathFin.spectralRisk_convex_combination_normalized
statement:
theorem spectralRisk_convex_combination_normalized
    (s : Finset ι) (φ ψ : ι → ℝ) (t : ℝ)
    (hφ : ∑ i ∈ s, φ i = 1) (hψ : ∑ i ∈ s, ψ i = 1) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, (t * φ i + (1 - t) * ψ i) = 1

name: MathFin.spectralRisk_mono
statement:
theorem spectralRisk_mono (s : Finset ι) (φ Q Q' : ι → ℝ)
    (hφ : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ φ i) (hQ : ∀ i ∈ s, Q i ≤ Q' i) :
    spectralRiskFinite s φ Q ≤ spectralRiskFinite s φ Q'

name: MathFin.spectralRisk_translation
statement:
theorem spectralRisk_translation (s : Finset ι) (φ : ι → ℝ) (Q : ι → ℝ)
    (c : ℝ) (h_norm : ∑ i ∈ s, φ i = 1) :
    spectralRiskFinite s φ (fun i ↦ Q i + c) =
      spectralRiskFinite s φ Q + c

name: MathFin.acceptableUnderUtility_convex
statement:
theorem acceptableUnderUtility_convex
    {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (p : ι → ℝ) (u : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℝ)
    (hp_nonneg : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ p i)
    (h_concave : ∀ x y : ℝ, ∀ α : ℝ, 0 ≤ α → α ≤ 1 →
      α * u x + (1 - α) * u y ≤ u (α * x + (1 - α) * y))
    {X Y : ι → ℝ} {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 ≤ α) (hα1 : α ≤ 1)
    (hX : acceptableUnderUtility s p u W X)
    (hY : acceptableUnderUtility s p u W Y) :
    acceptableUnderUtility s p u W (fun i ↦ α * X i + (1 - α) * Y i)

name: MathFin.acceptableUnderUtility_monotone_translation
statement:
theorem acceptableUnderUtility_monotone_translation
    {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (p : ι → ℝ) (u : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℝ)
    (hp_nonneg : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ p i)
    (h_mono : Monotone u)
    {X : ι → ℝ} {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hX : acceptableUnderUtility s p u W X) :
    acceptableUnderUtility s p u W (fun i ↦ X i + c)

name: MathFin.acceptableUnderUtility_zero
statement:
theorem acceptableUnderUtility_zero
    {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (p : ι → ℝ) (u : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℝ)
    (h_p_sum : ∑ i ∈ s, p i = 1) :
    acceptableUnderUtility s p u W (fun _ ↦ 0)

name: MathFin.exists_mix_weight
statement:
theorem exists_mix_weight {P Q R : ℝ} (hpq : Q < P) (hqr : R < Q) :
    ∃ α : ℝ, 0 < α ∧ α < 1 ∧ α * P + (1 - α) * R = Q

name: MathFin.expectedUtility_affine
statement:
theorem expectedUtility_affine (s : Finset ι) (u : ι → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) {p : ι → ℝ}
    (hp : ∑ i ∈ s, p i = 1) :
    expectedUtility s (fun i ↦ a * u i + b) p
      = a * expectedUtility s u p + b

name: MathFin.expectedUtility_mix
statement:
theorem expectedUtility_mix (s : Finset ι) (u : ι → ℝ) (α : ℝ) (p q : ι → ℝ) :
    expectedUtility s u (mix α p q)
      = α * expectedUtility s u p + (1 - α) * expectedUtility s u q

name: MathFin.mix_comm
statement: theorem mix_comm (α : ℝ) (p q : ι → ℝ) : mix α p q = mix (1 - α) q p

name: MathFin.mix_compound
statement:
theorem mix_compound (α β : ℝ) (p q : ι → ℝ) :
    mix α (mix β p q) q = mix (α * β) p q

name: MathFin.mix_nonneg
MathFin.mix_one
statement: theorem mix_one (p q : ι → ℝ) : mix 1 p q = p

name: MathFin.mix_self
statement: theorem mix_self (α : ℝ) (p : ι → ℝ) : mix α p p = p

name: MathFin.mix_zero
statement: theorem mix_zero (p q : ι → ℝ) : mix 0 p q = q

MathFin.prefersEU_continuity
statement:
theorem prefersEU_continuity (s : Finset ι) (u : ι → ℝ) {p q r : ι → ℝ}
    (hpq : expectedUtility s u q < expectedUtility s u p)
    (hqr : expectedUtility s u r < expectedUtility s u q) :
    ∃ α : ℝ, 0 < α ∧ α < 1 ∧
      expectedUtility s u (mix α p r) = expectedUtility s u q

name: MathFin.prefersEU_independence
statement:
theorem prefersEU_independence (s : Finset ι) (u : ι → ℝ) {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 ≤ α)
    {p q r : ι → ℝ} (h : prefersEU s u p q) :
    prefersEU s u (mix α p r) (mix α q r)

name: MathFin.prefersEU_refl
statement:
theorem prefersEU_refl (s : Finset ι) (u : ι → ℝ) (p : ι → ℝ) :

statement:
theorem prefersEU_total (s : Finset ι) (u : ι → ℝ) (p q : ι → ℝ) :
